What is the process for completing a property purchase from a developer in Phuket?

The process of purchasing property from a developer in Thailand can seem complex, especially if you are dealing with local legal procedures for the first time. However, by following a clear sequence of steps with a professional agency, you can safely and successfully acquire your new home or apartment in Phuket. Below are the main stages of this process.

Choosing the Right Property with an Independent Market Expert

The first step in purchasing real estate is selecting a property that meets your requirements and expectations. It is recommended to consult with an independent market expert who can help assess the prospects of various properties and provide up-to-date information about developers and the terms of the deal.

After choosing a property, you will proceed to sign a reservation agreement. It is important to carefully review the terms of the agreement, as it formalizes your intention to purchase the specific property. Along with signing the agreement, a deposit is required, the amount of which is set by the developer. Typically, the deposit ranges from 100,000 THB to 2% of the property price. This deposit confirms your commitment and ensures that the property you selected will be reserved for you.

Drafting, Reviewing, and Signing the Sales and Purchase Agreement

The next important step is the preparation of the main sales and purchase agreement. At this stage, the lawyers of both parties review the contract, making necessary changes and clarifications. Once everything is in order, the agreement is signed. This process can take up to 30 calendar days, depending on the conditions outlined in the reservation agreement. Signing the sales and purchase agreement legally solidifies the obligations of both parties and sets the stage for further payment actions.

After signing the main contract, it is time to make the first major payment, which usually ranges from 20% to 33% of the total property price. Further payments are made according to the schedule outlined in the reservation agreement. These can be either a lump sum payment or a series of regular payments during the construction phase.

Once the property is ready, the process of registering ownership begins. This procedure is usually handled by the developer and their legal team, although you can also appoint your independent lawyer to manage the registration. The registration process at the Land Department takes between 10 to 45 days. It is important to ensure that all documents are properly completed and registered.

What is the process for completing a property purchase from a developer in Phuket?

The process of purchasing property from a developer in Thailand can seem complex, especially if you are dealing with local legal procedures for the first time. However, by following a clear sequence of steps with a professional agency, you can safely and successfully acquire your new home or apartment in Phuket. Below are the main stages of this process.

Choosing the Right Property with an Independent Market Expert

The first step in purchasing real estate is selecting a property that meets your requirements and expectations. It is recommended to consult with an independent market expert who can help assess the prospects of various properties and provide up-to-date information about developers and the terms of the deal.

After choosing a property, you will proceed to sign a reservation agreement. It is important to carefully review the terms of the agreement, as it formalizes your intention to purchase the specific property. Along with signing the agreement, a deposit is required, the amount of which is set by the developer. Typically, the deposit ranges from 100,000 THB to 2% of the property price. This deposit confirms your commitment and ensures that the property you selected will be reserved for you.

Drafting, Reviewing, and Signing the Sales and Purchase Agreement

The next important step is the preparation of the main sales and purchase agreement. At this stage, the lawyers of both parties review the contract, making necessary changes and clarifications. Once everything is in order, the agreement is signed. This process can take up to 30 calendar days, depending on the conditions outlined in the reservation agreement. Signing the sales and purchase agreement legally solidifies the obligations of both parties and sets the stage for further payment actions.

After signing the main contract, it is time to make the first major payment, which usually ranges from 20% to 33% of the total property price. Further payments are made according to the schedule outlined in the reservation agreement. These can be either a lump sum payment or a series of regular payments during the construction phase.

Once the property is ready, the process of registering ownership begins. This procedure is usually handled by the developer and their legal team, although you can also appoint your independent lawyer to manage the registration. The registration process at the Land Department takes between 10 to 45 days. It is important to ensure that all documents are properly completed and registered.

After the ownership registration process is completed, you will receive a final bill for the remaining amount. Once full payment is made, you will receive documents confirming your ownership of the property. At this stage, you officially become the owner of your new home or apartment in Phuket.

name: Bang Tao — PEYLAA Phuket Autograph Collection Residences · Apartments · 3 bedroom
description:
PEYLAA Phuket Autograph Collection Residences | Apartments | 3 bedroom

PEYLAA Phuket Autograph Collection Residences is a branded residential development managed by Marriott International, located in the Bang Tao area. It is the first Autograph Collection Residences project in Phuket and the first development under this brand in the Asia-Pacific region.

The project combines private residential living with Marriott’s international standards. The brand’s requirements apply not only to service, but also to the architecture, engineering systems, residence specifications, shared facilities and ongoing property management. This approach is designed to maintain the quality of the development and preserve its long-term investment appeal.

The complex is situated in one of Phuket’s most sought-after areas, just 500 metres from Boat Avenue and less than two kilometres from Bang Tao Beach.

Porto de Phuket, Laguna Golf, VitalLife Scientific Wellness Center, Bangkok Hospital Clinic Bangtao and several international schools, including HeadStart, UWC and British International School, are also located nearby.

Phuket International Airport is approximately 17 kilometres from the development.

The project comprises three seven-storey residential buildings with a total of 408 residences.

Buyers can choose from one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments ranging from 45 to 129 sq.m. In addition to the residential component, the development will include commercial spaces and a five-star Marriott hotel, scheduled to open after the residences have been completed.

All residences will be delivered fully finished and equipped with furniture, household appliances and textiles.

The facilities are designed for both permanent living and extended stays. The development will feature three 25-metre swimming pools, a modern fitness centre, dedicated yoga and Pilates spaces, saunas, ice baths, a library, coworking areas, a children’s club staffed by Marriott, a rooftop lounge and BBQ area above the main lobby, a tennis court and landscaped green spaces.

Once the hotel component opens, owners will also be able to access selected Marriott services and restaurants under preferential terms.

Particular attention has been paid to the project’s technical specifications. Ceiling heights are 2.8 metres, external walls are 20 centimetres thick, and double-glazed windows provide a high level of sound insulation.

The development is pet-friendly, with pets weighing up to 10 kg permitted in all three buildings.

Several property management options will be available to owners. Before the hotel opens, residences may participate in the Siviri rental programme. Once the hotel becomes operational, owners will have the option to transfer their residences to Marriott management.

The combination of an international brand, a central Bang Tao location, established surrounding infrastructure and Marriott standards makes the project attractive both for private residence and as an investment with future rental potential.

What is the process for completing a property purchase from a developer in Phuket?

The process of purchasing property from a developer in Thailand can seem complex, especially if you are dealing with local legal procedures for the first time. However, by following a clear sequence of steps with a professional agency, you can safely and successfully acquire your new home or apartment in Phuket. Below are the main stages of this process.

Choosing the Right Property with an Independent Market Expert

The first step in purchasing real estate is selecting a property that meets your requirements and expectations. It is recommended to consult with an independent market expert who can help assess the prospects of various properties and provide up-to-date information about developers and the terms of the deal.

After choosing a property, you will proceed to sign a reservation agreement. It is important to carefully review the terms of the agreement, as it formalizes your intention to purchase the specific property. Along with signing the agreement, a deposit is required, the amount of which is set by the developer. Typically, the deposit ranges from 100,000 THB to 2% of the property price. This deposit confirms your commitment and ensures that the property you selected will be reserved for you.

Drafting, Reviewing, and Signing the Sales and Purchase Agreement

The next important step is the preparation of the main sales and purchase agreement. At this stage, the lawyers of both parties review the contract, making necessary changes and clarifications. Once everything is in order, the agreement is signed. This process can take up to 30 calendar days, depending on the conditions outlined in the reservation agreement. Signing the sales and purchase agreement legally solidifies the obligations of both parties and sets the stage for further payment actions.

After signing the main contract, it is time to make the first major payment, which usually ranges from 20% to 33% of the total property price. Further payments are made according to the schedule outlined in the reservation agreement. These can be either a lump sum payment or a series of regular payments during the construction phase.

Once the property is ready, the process of registering ownership begins. This procedure is usually handled by the developer and their legal team, although you can also appoint your independent lawyer to manage the registration. The registration process at the Land Department takes between 10 to 45 days. It is important to ensure that all documents are properly completed and registered.

After the ownership registration process is completed, you will receive a final bill for the remaining amount. Once full payment is made, you will receive documents confirming your ownership of the property. At this stage, you officially become the owner of your new home or apartment in Phuket.

Purchasing property from a developer in Thailand is a process that requires attention to detail and adherence to legal procedures. Our specialists at Get Your Phuket are ready to guide you every step of the way, ensuring the safety and success of your transaction.

What is the process for completing a property purchase from a developer in Phuket?

The process of purchasing property from a developer in Thailand can seem complex, especially if you are dealing with local legal procedures for the first time. However, by following a clear sequence of steps with a professional agency, you can safely and successfully acquire your new home or apartment in Phuket. Below are the main stages of this process.

Choosing the Right Property with an Independent Market Expert

The first step in purchasing real estate is selecting a property that meets your requirements and expectations. It is recommended to consult with an independent market expert who can help assess the prospects of various properties and provide up-to-date information about developers and the terms of the deal.

After choosing a property, you will proceed to sign a reservation agreement. It is important to carefully review the terms of the agreement, as it formalizes your intention to purchase the specific property. Along with signing the agreement, a deposit is required, the amount of which is set by the developer. Typically, the deposit ranges from 100,000 THB to 2% of the property price. This deposit confirms your commitment and ensures that the property you selected will be reserved for you.

Drafting, Reviewing, and Signing the Sales and Purchase Agreement

The next important step is the preparation of the main sales and purchase agreement. At this stage, the lawyers of both parties review the contract, making necessary changes and clarifications. Once everything is in order, the agreement is signed. This process can take up to 30 calendar days, depending on the conditions outlined in the reservation agreement. Signing the sales and purchase agreement legally solidifies the obligations of both parties and sets the stage for further payment actions.

After signing the main contract, it is time to make the first major payment, which usually ranges from 20% to 33% of the total property price. Further payments are made according to the schedule outlined in the reservation agreement. These can be either a lump sum payment or a series of regular payments during the construction phase.

Once the property is ready, the process of registering ownership begins. This procedure is usually handled by the developer and their legal team, although you can also appoint your independent lawyer to manage the registration. The registration process at the Land Department takes between 10 to 45 days. It is important to ensure that all documents are properly completed and registered.

After the ownership registration process is completed, you will receive a final bill for the remaining amount. Once full payment is made, you will receive documents confirming your ownership of the property. At this stage, you officially become the owner of your new home or apartment in Phuket.

Purchasing property from a developer in Thailand is a process that requires attention to detail and adherence to legal procedures. Our specialists at Get Your Phuket are ready to guide you every step of the way, ensuring the safety and success of your transaction.

What is the process for completing a property purchase from a developer in Phuket?

The process of purchasing property from a developer in Thailand can seem complex, especially if you are dealing with local legal procedures for the first time. However, by following a clear sequence of steps with a professional agency, you can safely and successfully acquire your new home or apartment in Phuket. Below are the main stages of this process.

Choosing the Right Property with an Independent Market Expert

The first step in purchasing real estate is selecting a property that meets your requirements and expectations. It is recommended to consult with an independent market expert who can help assess the prospects of various properties and provide up-to-date information about developers and the terms of the deal.

After choosing a property, you will proceed to sign a reservation agreement. It is important to carefully review the terms of the agreement, as it formalizes your intention to purchase the specific property. Along with signing the agreement, a deposit is required, the amount of which is set by the developer. Typically, the deposit ranges from 100,000 THB to 2% of the property price. This deposit confirms your commitment and ensures that the property you selected will be reserved for you.

Drafting, Reviewing, and Signing the Sales and Purchase Agreement

The next important step is the preparation of the main sales and purchase agreement. At this stage, the lawyers of both parties review the contract, making necessary changes and clarifications. Once everything is in order, the agreement is signed. This process can take up to 30 calendar days, depending on the conditions outlined in the reservation agreement. Signing the sales and purchase agreement legally solidifies the obligations of both parties and sets the stage for further payment actions.

After signing the main contract, it is time to make the first major payment, which usually ranges from 20% to 33% of the total property price. Further payments are made according to the schedule outlined in the reservation agreement. These can be either a lump sum payment or a series of regular payments during the construction phase.

Once the property is ready, the process of registering ownership begins. This procedure is usually handled by the developer and their legal team, although you can also appoint your independent lawyer to manage the registration. The registration process at the Land Department takes between 10 to 45 days. It is important to ensure that all documents are properly completed and registered.

After the ownership registration process is completed, you will receive a final bill for the remaining amount. Once full payment is made, you will receive documents confirming your ownership of the property. At this stage, you officially become the owner of your new home or apartment in Phuket.

Purchasing property from a developer in Thailand is a process that requires attention to detail and adherence to legal procedures. Our specialists at Get Your Phuket are ready to guide you every step of the way, ensuring the safety and success of your transaction.

What is the process for completing a property purchase from a developer in Phuket?

The process of purchasing property from a developer in Thailand can seem complex, especially if you are dealing with local legal procedures for the first time. However, by following a clear sequence of steps with a professional agency, you can safely and successfully acquire your new home or apartment in Phuket. Below are the main stages of this process.

Choosing the Right Property with an Independent Market Expert

The first step in purchasing real estate is selecting a property that meets your requirements and expectations. It is recommended to consult with an independent market expert who can help assess the prospects of various properties and provide up-to-date information about developers and the terms of the deal.

After choosing a property, you will proceed to sign a reservation agreement. It is important to carefully review the terms of the agreement, as it formalizes your intention to purchase the specific property. Along with signing the agreement, a deposit is required, the amount of which is set by the developer. Typically, the deposit ranges from 100,000 THB to 2% of the property price. This deposit confirms your commitment and ensures that the property you selected will be reserved for you.

Drafting, Reviewing, and Signing the Sales and Purchase Agreement

The next important step is the preparation of the main sales and purchase agreement. At this stage, the lawyers of both parties review the contract, making necessary changes and clarifications. Once everything is in order, the agreement is signed. This process can take up to 30 calendar days, depending on the conditions outlined in the reservation agreement. Signing the sales and purchase agreement legally solidifies the obligations of both parties and sets the stage for further payment actions.

After signing the main contract, it is time to make the first major payment, which usually ranges from 20% to 33% of the total property price. Further payments are made according to the schedule outlined in the reservation agreement. These can be either a lump sum payment or a series of regular payments during the construction phase.

Once the property is ready, the process of registering ownership begins. This procedure is usually handled by the developer and their legal team, although you can also appoint your independent lawyer to manage the registration. The registration process at the Land Department takes between 10 to 45 days. It is important to ensure that all documents are properly completed and registered.

After the ownership registration process is completed, you will receive a final bill for the remaining amount. Once full payment is made, you will receive documents confirming your ownership of the property. At this stage, you officially become the owner of your new home or apartment in Phuket.

Purchasing property from a developer in Thailand is a process that requires attention to detail and adherence to legal procedures. Our specialists at Get Your Phuket are ready to guide you every step of the way, ensuring the safety and success of your transaction.

Size: Tri Vananda spans across 96 hectares, with only 15% of the land being used for construction.

Sustainability: The project emphasizes sustainable development and integration with nature.

Main Feature: A Health Resort by the world-renowned Clinique La Prairie, specializing in integrative and functional medicine, cognitive health, and mental well-being. The resort will be equipped with consultation rooms, physiotherapy facilities, and traditional Chinese medicine clinics.

Other Amenities: The complex includes a meditation center, a spa with thermal zones, a fitness center with a 50-meter swimming pool, and a pier for water sports.

Restaurant: JAMPA, awarded the Green Michelin Star for its commitment to sustainability, offers dishes made from seasonal products grown on the project’s own farm or sourced from local producers.

Community Center: A venue for events and socializing among residents.

Children’s Space: Includes the Tweenie Club, designed for children aged 8 to 14, with opportunities for both learning and play.

Wellness Facilities: A swimming pool, a modern gym, and various wellness offerings to promote physical health and well-being.

Exclusive Access: Owners will also have access to the services and beach at the Trisara resort.

Customizable Villas: Residents can choose the location of their villa and customize the floor plan. Seven different villa layouts are available, ranging from 2 to 4 bedrooms and from 325 m² to 853 m² in size.

Phase 1 Villas: The first phase of Tri Vananda’s residential villas is available for investment. With the opening of the Health Resort by Clinique La Prairie in 2026, demand for these exclusive villas is expected to grow. By reserving a plot now, you can secure your participation in this exceptional project.

Proximity: Just 15 minutes from Phuket International Airport and a few minutes from pristine beaches, a marina, a national park, shopping malls, UWC International School, and a hospital.

Natural Surroundings: The project is surrounded by forests and lakes, harmoniously blending with nature, promoting a peaceful and healthy living environment.

On-site Wellness Services: Modern health and wellness facilities directly within the project.

Farming: Organic farming and educational programs for children.

What is the process for completing a property purchase from a developer in Phuket?

The process of purchasing property from a developer in Thailand can seem complex, especially if you are dealing with local legal procedures for the first time. However, by following a clear sequence of steps with a professional agency, you can safely and successfully acquire your new home or apartment in Phuket. Below are the main stages of this process.

Choosing the Right Property with an Independent Market Expert

The first step in purchasing real estate is selecting a property that meets your requirements and expectations. It is recommended to consult with an independent market expert who can help assess the prospects of various properties and provide up-to-date information about developers and the terms of the deal.

After choosing a property, you will proceed to sign a reservation agreement. It is important to carefully review the terms of the agreement, as it formalizes your intention to purchase the specific property. Along with signing the agreement, a deposit is required, the amount of which is set by the developer. Typically, the deposit ranges from 100,000 THB to 2% of the property price. This deposit confirms your commitment and ensures that the property you selected will be reserved for you.

Drafting, Reviewing, and Signing the Sales and Purchase Agreement

The next important step is the preparation of the main sales and purchase agreement. At this stage, the lawyers of both parties review the contract, making necessary changes and clarifications. Once everything is in order, the agreement is signed. This process can take up to 30 calendar days, depending on the conditions outlined in the reservation agreement. Signing the sales and purchase agreement legally solidifies the obligations of both parties and sets the stage for further payment actions.

After signing the main contract, it is time to make the first major payment, which usually ranges from 20% to 33% of the total property price. Further payments are made according to the schedule outlined in the reservation agreement. These can be either a lump sum payment or a series of regular payments during the construction phase.

Once the property is ready, the process of registering ownership begins. This procedure is usually handled by the developer and their legal team, although you can also appoint your independent lawyer to manage the registration. The registration process at the Land Department takes between 10 to 45 days. It is important to ensure that all documents are properly completed and registered.

After the ownership registration process is completed, you will receive a final bill for the remaining amount. Once full payment is made, you will receive documents confirming your ownership of the property. At this stage, you officially become the owner of your new home or apartment in Phuket.

Purchasing property from a developer in Thailand is a process that requires attention to detail and adherence to legal procedures. Our specialists at Get Your Phuket are ready to guide you every step of the way, ensuring the safety and success of your transaction.

What is the process for completing a property purchase from a developer in Phuket?

The process of purchasing property from a developer in Thailand can seem complex, especially if you are dealing with local legal procedures for the first time. However, by following a clear sequence of steps with a professional agency, you can safely and successfully acquire your new home or apartment in Phuket. Below are the main stages of this process.

Choosing the Right Property with an Independent Market Expert

The first step in purchasing real estate is selecting a property that meets your requirements and expectations. It is recommended to consult with an independent market expert who can help assess the prospects of various properties and provide up-to-date information about developers and the terms of the deal.

After choosing a property, you will proceed to sign a reservation agreement. It is important to carefully review the terms of the agreement, as it formalizes your intention to purchase the specific property. Along with signing the agreement, a deposit is required, the amount of which is set by the developer. Typically, the deposit ranges from 100,000 THB to 2% of the property price. This deposit confirms your commitment and ensures that the property you selected will be reserved for you.

Drafting, Reviewing, and Signing the Sales and Purchase Agreement

The next important step is the preparation of the main sales and purchase agreement. At this stage, the lawyers of both parties review the contract, making necessary changes and clarifications. Once everything is in order, the agreement is signed. This process can take up to 30 calendar days, depending on the conditions outlined in the reservation agreement. Signing the sales and purchase agreement legally solidifies the obligations of both parties and sets the stage for further payment actions.

After signing the main contract, it is time to make the first major payment, which usually ranges from 20% to 33% of the total property price. Further payments are made according to the schedule outlined in the reservation agreement. These can be either a lump sum payment or a series of regular payments during the construction phase.

Once the property is ready, the process of registering ownership begins. This procedure is usually handled by the developer and their legal team, although you can also appoint your independent lawyer to manage the registration. The registration process at the Land Department takes between 10 to 45 days. It is important to ensure that all documents are properly completed and registered.

After the ownership registration process is completed, you will receive a final bill for the remaining amount. Once full payment is made, you will receive documents confirming your ownership of the property. At this stage, you officially become the owner of your new home or apartment in Phuket.

Purchasing property from a developer in Thailand is a process that requires attention to detail and adherence to legal procedures. Our specialists at Get Your Phuket are ready to guide you every step of the way, ensuring the safety and success of your transaction.

What is the process for completing a property purchase from a developer in Phuket?

The process of purchasing property from a developer in Thailand can seem complex, especially if you are dealing with local legal procedures for the first time. However, by following a clear sequence of steps with a professional agency, you can safely and successfully acquire your new home or apartment in Phuket. Below are the main stages of this process.

Choosing the Right Property with an Independent Market Expert

The first step in purchasing real estate is selecting a property that meets your requirements and expectations. It is recommended to consult with an independent market expert who can help assess the prospects of various properties and provide up-to-date information about developers and the terms of the deal.

After choosing a property, you will proceed to sign a reservation agreement. It is important to carefully review the terms of the agreement, as it formalizes your intention to purchase the specific property. Along with signing the agreement, a deposit is required, the amount of which is set by the developer. Typically, the deposit ranges from 100,000 THB to 2% of the property price. This deposit confirms your commitment and ensures that the property you selected will be reserved for you.

Drafting, Reviewing, and Signing the Sales and Purchase Agreement

The next important step is the preparation of the main sales and purchase agreement. At this stage, the lawyers of both parties review the contract, making necessary changes and clarifications. Once everything is in order, the agreement is signed. This process can take up to 30 calendar days, depending on the conditions outlined in the reservation agreement. Signing the sales and purchase agreement legally solidifies the obligations of both parties and sets the stage for further payment actions.

After signing the main contract, it is time to make the first major payment, which usually ranges from 20% to 33% of the total property price. Further payments are made according to the schedule outlined in the reservation agreement. These can be either a lump sum payment or a series of regular payments during the construction phase.

Once the property is ready, the process of registering ownership begins. This procedure is usually handled by the developer and their legal team, although you can also appoint your independent lawyer to manage the registration. The registration process at the Land Department takes between 10 to 45 days. It is important to ensure that all documents are properly completed and registered.

After the ownership registration process is completed, you will receive a final bill for the remaining amount. Once full payment is made, you will receive documents confirming your ownership of the property. At this stage, you officially become the owner of your new home or apartment in Phuket.

Purchasing property from a developer in Thailand is a process that requires attention to detail and adherence to legal procedures. Our specialists at Get Your Phuket are ready to guide you every step of the way, ensuring the safety and success of your transaction.

What is the process for completing a property purchase from a developer in Phuket?

The process of purchasing property from a developer in Thailand can seem complex, especially if you are dealing with local legal procedures for the first time. However, by following a clear sequence of steps with a professional agency, you can safely and successfully acquire your new home or apartment in Phuket. Below are the main stages of this process.

Choosing the Right Property with an Independent Market Expert

The first step in purchasing real estate is selecting a property that meets your requirements and expectations. It is recommended to consult with an independent market expert who can help assess the prospects of various properties and provide up-to-date information about developers and the terms of the deal.

After choosing a property, you will proceed to sign a reservation agreement. It is important to carefully review the terms of the agreement, as it formalizes your intention to purchase the specific property. Along with signing the agreement, a deposit is required, the amount of which is set by the developer. Typically, the deposit ranges from 100,000 THB to 2% of the property price. This deposit confirms your commitment and ensures that the property you selected will be reserved for you.

Drafting, Reviewing, and Signing the Sales and Purchase Agreement

The next important step is the preparation of the main sales and purchase agreement. At this stage, the lawyers of both parties review the contract, making necessary changes and clarifications. Once everything is in order, the agreement is signed. This process can take up to 30 calendar days, depending on the conditions outlined in the reservation agreement. Signing the sales and purchase agreement legally solidifies the obligations of both parties and sets the stage for further payment actions.

After signing the main contract, it is time to make the first major payment, which usually ranges from 20% to 33% of the total property price. Further payments are made according to the schedule outlined in the reservation agreement. These can be either a lump sum payment or a series of regular payments during the construction phase.

What is the process for completing a property purchase from a developer in Phuket?

The process of purchasing property from a developer in Thailand can seem complex, especially if you are dealing with local legal procedures for the first time. However, by following a clear sequence of steps with a professional agency, you can safely and successfully acquire your new home or apartment in Phuket. Below are the main stages of this process.

Choosing the Right Property with an Independent Market Expert

The first step in purchasing real estate is selecting a property that meets your requirements and expectations. It is recommended to consult with an independent market expert who can help assess the prospects of various properties and provide up-to-date information about developers and the terms of the deal.

After choosing a property, you will proceed to sign a reservation agreement. It is important to carefully review the terms of the agreement, as it formalizes your intention to purchase the specific property. Along with signing the agreement, a deposit is required, the amount of which is set by the developer. Typically, the deposit ranges from 100,000 THB to 2% of the property price. This deposit confirms your commitment and ensures that the property you selected will be reserved for you.

Drafting, Reviewing, and Signing the Sales and Purchase Agreement

The next important step is the preparation of the main sales and purchase agreement. At this stage, the lawyers of both parties review the contract, making necessary changes and clarifications. Once everything is in order, the agreement is signed. This process can take up to 30 calendar days, depending on the conditions outlined in the reservation agreement. Signing the sales and purchase agreement legally solidifies the obligations of both parties and sets the stage for further payment actions.

After signing the main contract, it is time to make the first major payment, which usually ranges from 20% to 33% of the total property price. Further payments are made according to the schedule outlined in the reservation agreement. These can be either a lump sum payment or a series of regular payments during the construction phase.

Once the property is ready, the process of registering ownership begins. This procedure is usually handled by the developer and their legal team, although you can also appoint your independent lawyer to manage the registration. The registration process at the Land Department takes between 10 to 45 days. It is important to ensure that all documents are properly completed and registered.

After the ownership registration process is completed, you will receive a final bill for the remaining amount. Once full payment is made, you will receive documents confirming your ownership of the property. At this stage, you officially become the owner of your new home or apartment in Phuket.

Purchasing property from a developer in Thailand is a process that requires attention to detail and adherence to legal procedures. Our specialists at Get Your Phuket are ready to guide you every step of the way, ensuring the safety and success of your transaction.

What is the process for completing a property purchase from a developer in Phuket?

The process of purchasing property from a developer in Thailand can seem complex, especially if you are dealing with local legal procedures for the first time. However, by following a clear sequence of steps with a professional agency, you can safely and successfully acquire your new home or apartment in Phuket. Below are the main stages of this process.

Choosing the Right Property with an Independent Market Expert

The first step in purchasing real estate is selecting a property that meets your requirements and expectations. It is recommended to consult with an independent market expert who can help assess the prospects of various properties and provide up-to-date information about developers and the terms of the deal.

After choosing a property, you will proceed to sign a reservation agreement. It is important to carefully review the terms of the agreement, as it formalizes your intention to purchase the specific property. Along with signing the agreement, a deposit is required, the amount of which is set by the developer. Typically, the deposit ranges from 100,000 THB to 2% of the property price. This deposit confirms your commitment and ensures that the property you selected will be reserved for you.

Drafting, Reviewing, and Signing the Sales and Purchase Agreement

The next important step is the preparation of the main sales and purchase agreement. At this stage, the lawyers of both parties review the contract, making necessary changes and clarifications. Once everything is in order, the agreement is signed. This process can take up to 30 calendar days, depending on the conditions outlined in the reservation agreement. Signing the sales and purchase agreement legally solidifies the obligations of both parties and sets the stage for further payment actions.

After signing the main contract, it is time to make the first major payment, which usually ranges from 20% to 33% of the total property price. Further payments are made according to the schedule outlined in the reservation agreement. These can be either a lump sum payment or a series of regular payments during the construction phase.

Once the property is ready, the process of registering ownership begins. This procedure is usually handled by the developer and their legal team, although you can also appoint your independent lawyer to manage the registration. The registration process at the Land Department takes between 10 to 45 days. It is important to ensure that all documents are properly completed and registered.

After the ownership registration process is completed, you will receive a final bill for the remaining amount. Once full payment is made, you will receive documents confirming your ownership of the property. At this stage, you officially become the owner of your new home or apartment in Phuket.

What is the process for completing a property purchase from a developer in Phuket?

The process of purchasing property from a developer in Thailand can seem complex, especially if you are dealing with local legal procedures for the first time. However, by following a clear sequence of steps with a professional agency, you can safely and successfully acquire your new home or apartment in Phuket. Below are the main stages of this process.

Choosing the Right Property with an Independent Market Expert

The first step in purchasing real estate is selecting a property that meets your requirements and expectations. It is recommended to consult with an independent market expert who can help assess the prospects of various properties and provide up-to-date information about developers and the terms of the deal.

After choosing a property, you will proceed to sign a reservation agreement. It is important to carefully review the terms of the agreement, as it formalizes your intention to purchase the specific property. Along with signing the agreement, a deposit is required, the amount of which is set by the developer. Typically, the deposit ranges from 100,000 THB to 2% of the property price. This deposit confirms your commitment and ensures that the property you selected will be reserved for you.

name: Bang Tao — PEYLAA Phuket Autograph Collection Residences · Apartments · 1 bedroom
description:
PEYLAA Phuket Autograph Collection Residences | Apartments | 1 bedroom

PEYLAA Phuket Autograph Collection Residences is a branded residential development managed by Marriott International, located in the Bang Tao area. It is the first Autograph Collection Residences project in Phuket and the first development under this brand in the Asia-Pacific region.

The project combines private residential living with Marriott’s international standards. The brand’s requirements apply not only to service, but also to the architecture, engineering systems, residence specifications, shared facilities and ongoing property management. This approach is designed to maintain the quality of the development and preserve its long-term investment appeal.

The complex is situated in one of Phuket’s most sought-after areas, just 500 metres from Boat Avenue and less than two kilometres from Bang Tao Beach.

Porto de Phuket, Laguna Golf, VitalLife Scientific Wellness Center, Bangkok Hospital Clinic Bangtao and several international schools, including HeadStart, UWC and British International School, are also located nearby.

Phuket International Airport is approximately 17 kilometres from the development.

The project comprises three seven-storey residential buildings with a total of 408 residences.

Buyers can choose from one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments ranging from 45 to 129 sq.m. In addition to the residential component, the development will include commercial spaces and a five-star Marriott hotel, scheduled to open after the residences have been completed.

All residences will be delivered fully finished and equipped with furniture, household appliances and textiles.

The facilities are designed for both permanent living and extended stays. The development will feature three 25-metre swimming pools, a modern fitness centre, dedicated yoga and Pilates spaces, saunas, ice baths, a library, coworking areas, a children’s club staffed by Marriott, a rooftop lounge and BBQ area above the main lobby, a tennis court and landscaped green spaces.

Once the hotel component opens, owners will also be able to access selected Marriott services and restaurants under preferential terms.

Particular attention has been paid to the project’s technical specifications. Ceiling heights are 2.8 metres, external walls are 20 centimetres thick, and double-glazed windows provide a high level of sound insulation.

The development is pet-friendly, with pets weighing up to 10 kg permitted in all three buildings.

Several property management options will be available to owners. Before the hotel opens, residences may participate in the Siviri rental programme. Once the hotel becomes operational, owners will have the option to transfer their residences to Marriott management.

The combination of an international brand, a central Bang Tao location, established surrounding infrastructure and Marriott standards makes the project attractive both for private residence and as an investment with future rental potential.

3rd payment — 10% upon completion of the building structure.

5th payment — 45% upon handover and registration of ownership.

The project is a unique U-shaped residence, featuring teak wood paneling, marble, and handcrafted elements by renowned Thai artists. The villa combines traditional Thai craftsmanship with modern comfort, offering residents an unparalleled level of privacy and luxury.

The villa is situated in the Kata area on the west coast of Phuket, just a few minutes' walk from two of the island's finest white-sand beaches — Kata and Kata Noi. Adjacent to this is a charming outdoor sala lounge overlooking the terraced gardens and the sea. Every principal room offers uninterrupted panoramic views of the Andaman Sea and Kata Noi Beach.

The villa grounds feature a private infinity-edge swimming pool, a spacious terrace, and a large landscaped tropical garden with direct ocean access via a private pathway. The villa is finished with teak paneling, marble, and exclusive hand-painted wooden panels by a renowned Thai artist.

name: Thalang — The Gens by Botanica · Apartments · 1 bedroom
description:
The Gens by Botanica is a new premium residential complex in the Cherng Talai area, developed by Botanica Luxury Villa in partnership with Sure Estate.

The project is designed for comfortable everyday life on Phuket and combines modern apartments, well-developed family infrastructure, wellness spaces, and a convenient location near the area's key amenities.

Unlike projects primarily aimed at short-term tourist stays, The Gens by Botanica is created as a fully functional place for permanent and long-term living. The layouts, communal areas, and internal infrastructure of the complex are designed with the needs of families with children, pet owners, expats, and those who spend a significant part of the year on Phuket in mind.

The main concept of the project is to create a space for real life, where interiors and infrastructure are adapted to residents' daily needs. The apartments feature functional living areas, comfortable bedrooms, full-size kitchens, balconies, and concealed storage systems that allow for efficient use of space.

The Gens by Botanica is located in the Cherng Talai area — one of the most rapidly developing parts of Phuket.

Nearby are international schools, sports and family centers, restaurants, shops, and other infrastructure necessary for permanent living.

The distance to Blue Tree Phuket is approximately 100 meters.

The complex will be built on a plot of 4,758.4 m² and will include two 8-story residential buildings with underground parking. A total of 277 apartments are planned in the project.

There are 117 parking spaces for cars, which is approximately 42% of the total number of residences.

The project belongs to the Upper Class category and combines a boutique residential complex format with comprehensive internal infrastructure.

The Gens by Botanica offers 1-bedroom and 2-bedroom apartments. Five main layout types have been developed in total.

A compact and functional layout with a balcony spanning the full width of the apartment. Suitable for a single person, a couple, seasonal living, or long-term rental.

This layout features a transformable balcony area that can be used as additional relaxation space or as an extension of the apartment's living area.

A more spacious option with an enlarged living room, a full-size bedroom, and additional storage space. Suitable for those planning to spend extended periods in the apartment and wanting more personal space.

One of the key advantages of The Gens by Botanica is its infrastructure, designed for daily use. Communal spaces are created not only as a visual part of the project but also as a functional extension of the living environment.

Modern fitness club and zones for various types of physical activity;

Children's infrastructure (playgrounds, spaces for learning and socializing, as well as safe children's pools);

The Gens by Botanica allows living with pets in a specially designated part of the complex.

Pet-friendly apartments will be located in Building A on the second and third floors. The pet's weight must not exceed 15 kg. Living with exotic animals is prohibited.

Management of common areas and day-to-day operations of the complex is planned to be entrusted to the international company JLL — Jones Lang LaSalle.

name: Rawai — Sunny Moon Village · Villa · 3 bedrooms
description:
Sunny Moon Village is a new complex of premium family villas in southern Phuket, in the Nai Harn area. The project is created for those who are looking not just for a house by the sea, but for a comfortable, private space for living, relaxation, and long-term stay on the island.

The complex is located in one of the greenest and quietest parts of Phuket — near Nai Harn and Rawai beaches, Nai Harn Lake, and the Windmill Viewpoint and Promthep Cape viewpoints. This is an area with developed day-to-day infrastructure: nearby you will find restaurants, cafés, international schools and kindergartens, clinics, wellness centres, and everything needed for year-round living.

The project offers villas with 2, 3, and 4 bedrooms, from 149 to 215 m². Each villa is designed with a focus on privacy, functionality, and family comfort: spacious living areas, floor-to-ceiling glazing, a private pool, a relaxation terrace, and a thoughtful layout without unnecessary unused space.

The architecture of Sunny Moon Village is executed in a modern tropical style: natural materials, soft natural shades, wood, stone, and abundant greenery create the feeling of a peaceful resort home. The villas are equipped with a Smart Home system, solar panels, and personal charging stations for electric vehicles, making the project more technological and convenient for everyday life.

A special advantage of the project is its family concept. Sunny Moon Village is suitable for living with children and pets: the project is pet-friendly, and residents gain access to children's areas, development spaces, a co-working office, a café, a gym, a spa, and a padel court. A concierge service and a professional management company are also provided.

Nai Harn Beach is about 2.2 km away, and Rawai Beach is about 2.5 km away. Sunny Moon Village residents also gain access to the Sunny Moon infrastructure, located approximately 2 km from the complex, and a shuttle bus is provided between the projects and the beach.

Each villa is equipped with a private pool featuring a filtration system, a relaxation terrace, a Smart Home system for controlling climate, lighting, and security, as well as solar panels and a personal charging station for an electric vehicle.

The bathrooms include premium plumbing fixtures, including Grohe solutions.

Built-in furniture, freestanding furniture, appliances, and decorative elements are included.

name: Cherng Talay — The Liberty by Wallaya Villas · Apartments · 1 bedroom
description:
The Liberty by Wallaya Villas is a new residential project in Cherng Talay, one of the most convenient and fastest-growing locations in Phuket.

The project offers modern urban residences designed for comfortable living, featuring spacious layouts, its own commercial area, parking, swimming pools, a fitness center, a restaurant, children’s facilities, and quick access to the area’s everyday infrastructure.

One of the key advantages of the project is its direct private access to Blue Tree Phuket. This makes The Liberty especially convenient for families, active residents, and those who want to live close to established lifestyle infrastructure.

The Liberty is located in an area where a complete environment for everyday living has already been formed: international schools, supermarkets, cafés, sports clubs, family entertainment, Boat Avenue, Bang Tao Beach and Layan Beach are all within 5–10 minutes.

The main idea of the project is to combine the convenience of urban living with a more private and thoughtfully designed residential format. It is created for those who want to live close to all essential infrastructure while enjoying a modern, beautiful and functional living space.

The architecture of the project is designed in a contemporary style, with clean façade lines, large glass surfaces, warm finishing accents, and floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows.

The commercial area deserves special attention. For a project of this format, this is an important advantage: residents will not need to leave the complex every time they need basic everyday services. In the future, this area may become an attraction point not only for The Liberty residents, but also for people living in the surrounding neighborhoods.

Another important feature is that one of the buildings will be pet-friendly, which is especially relevant for families and residents planning to live in Phuket with their pets.

The project occupies a land plot of 8 rai, or approximately 12,800 sq.m. The Liberty will consist of 5 residential buildings, each with 7 floors. In total, the project will include 324 apartments with 1 and 2 bedrooms, as well as penthouses.

The Liberty is located in an area that has become one of the main lifestyle hubs of Phuket in recent years.

Villa Market, Porto de Phuket, cafés, restaurants, sports facilities, a tennis academy, a golf center and Bangkok Hospital are also located nearby.

The location is especially attractive for families. There are several schools nearby, as well as children’s and sports infrastructure, shops, restaurants and places for leisure. This is one of the most practical areas in Phuket: it is a place where you can not only enjoy holidays, but also build a full everyday lifestyle.

The project may be interesting both for personal residence and for investment. The area already has stable demand from families, expats, employees of international companies, digital professionals and people who come to Phuket not for a week, but for several months or even years.

Finishing touches, fully equipped bathrooms, air‑conditioning system, built‑in wardrobes and kitchen units, and a complete furniture package.

What is the process for completing a property purchase from a developer in Phuket?

The process of purchasing property from a developer in Thailand can seem complex, especially if you are dealing with local legal procedures for the first time. However, by following a clear sequence of steps with a professional agency, you can safely and successfully acquire your new home or apartment in Phuket. Below are the main stages of this process.

Choosing the Right Property with an Independent Market Expert

The first step in purchasing real estate is selecting a property that meets your requirements and expectations. It is recommended to consult with an independent market expert who can help assess the prospects of various properties and provide up-to-date information about developers and the terms of the deal.

After choosing a property, you will proceed to sign a reservation agreement. It is important to carefully review the terms of the agreement, as it formalizes your intention to purchase the specific property. Along with signing the agreement, a deposit is required, the amount of which is set by the developer. Typically, the deposit ranges from 100,000 THB to 2% of the property price. This deposit confirms your commitment and ensures that the property you selected will be reserved for you.

Drafting, Reviewing, and Signing the Sales and Purchase Agreement

The next important step is the preparation of the main sales and purchase agreement. At this stage, the lawyers of both parties review the contract, making necessary changes and clarifications. Once everything is in order, the agreement is signed. This process can take up to 30 calendar days, depending on the conditions outlined in the reservation agreement. Signing the sales and purchase agreement legally solidifies the obligations of both parties and sets the stage for further payment actions.

After signing the main contract, it is time to make the first major payment, which usually ranges from 20% to 33% of the total property price. Further payments are made according to the schedule outlined in the reservation agreement. These can be either a lump sum payment or a series of regular payments during the construction phase.

Once the property is ready, the process of registering ownership begins. This procedure is usually handled by the developer and their legal team, although you can also appoint your independent lawyer to manage the registration. The registration process at the Land Department takes between 10 to 45 days. It is important to ensure that all documents are properly completed and registered.

After the ownership registration process is completed, you will receive a final bill for the remaining amount. Once full payment is made, you will receive documents confirming your ownership of the property. At this stage, you officially become the owner of your new home or apartment in Phuket.

Purchasing property from a developer in Thailand is a process that requires attention to detail and adherence to legal procedures. Our specialists at Get Your Phuket are ready to guide you every step of the way, ensuring the safety and success of your transaction.

What is the process for completing a property purchase from a developer in Phuket?

The process of purchasing property from a developer in Thailand can seem complex, especially if you are dealing with local legal procedures for the first time. However, by following a clear sequence of steps with a professional agency, you can safely and successfully acquire your new home or apartment in Phuket. Below are the main stages of this process.

Choosing the Right Property with an Independent Market Expert

The first step in purchasing real estate is selecting a property that meets your requirements and expectations. It is recommended to consult with an independent market expert who can help assess the prospects of various properties and provide up-to-date information about developers and the terms of the deal.

After choosing a property, you will proceed to sign a reservation agreement. It is important to carefully review the terms of the agreement, as it formalizes your intention to purchase the specific property. Along with signing the agreement, a deposit is required, the amount of which is set by the developer. Typically, the deposit ranges from 100,000 THB to 2% of the property price. This deposit confirms your commitment and ensures that the property you selected will be reserved for you.

Drafting, Reviewing, and Signing the Sales and Purchase Agreement

The next important step is the preparation of the main sales and purchase agreement. At this stage, the lawyers of both parties review the contract, making necessary changes and clarifications. Once everything is in order, the agreement is signed. This process can take up to 30 calendar days, depending on the conditions outlined in the reservation agreement. Signing the sales and purchase agreement legally solidifies the obligations of both parties and sets the stage for further payment actions.

After signing the main contract, it is time to make the first major payment, which usually ranges from 20% to 33% of the total property price. Further payments are made according to the schedule outlined in the reservation agreement. These can be either a lump sum payment or a series of regular payments during the construction phase.

Once the property is ready, the process of registering ownership begins. This procedure is usually handled by the developer and their legal team, although you can also appoint your independent lawyer to manage the registration. The registration process at the Land Department takes between 10 to 45 days. It is important to ensure that all documents are properly completed and registered.

After the ownership registration process is completed, you will receive a final bill for the remaining amount. Once full payment is made, you will receive documents confirming your ownership of the property. At this stage, you officially become the owner of your new home or apartment in Phuket.

Purchasing property from a developer in Thailand is a process that requires attention to detail and adherence to legal procedures. Our specialists at Get Your Phuket are ready to guide you every step of the way, ensuring the safety and success of your transaction.

Casa de Monte is an intimate private villa project located in the Koh Kaew area — one of Phuket’s most convenient locations for permanent living.

Rather than focusing on a resort concept, the project emphasizes a high-quality family environment: nearby are international schools, marinas, retail, and urban infrastructure, while within the complex residents still enjoy a sense of tranquility and privacy. The estate comprises 37 villas spread across approximately 13 rai (around 21,000 sq.m). It includes one- and two-story homes with 3–4 bedrooms on plots ranging from 280 to 600 sq.m, all designed in authentic Tuscan style. Over 1,600 sq.m are dedicated to communal and green spaces, including a clubhouse, children’s playground, and landscaped common areas.

The clubhouse features a lobby, co-working space, kids’ room, sauna, fitness center, and games room. Outside, there’s a spacious terrace, a large swimming pool, and a children’s pool.

The development also includes its own park, commercial zones, and 109 parking spaces. For family-oriented residents, this thoughtful design offers not only aesthetic appeal but genuine everyday comfort.

Built-in appliances and furniture, including a kitchen set and cupboards.

What is the process for completing a property purchase from a developer in Phuket?

The process of purchasing property from a developer in Thailand can seem complex, especially if you are dealing with local legal procedures for the first time. However, by following a clear sequence of steps with a professional agency, you can safely and successfully acquire your new home or apartment in Phuket. Below are the main stages of this process.

Choosing the Right Property with an Independent Market Expert

The first step in purchasing real estate is selecting a property that meets your requirements and expectations. It is recommended to consult with an independent market expert who can help assess the prospects of various properties and provide up-to-date information about developers and the terms of the deal.

After choosing a property, you will proceed to sign a reservation agreement. It is important to carefully review the terms of the agreement, as it formalizes your intention to purchase the specific property. Along with signing the agreement, a deposit is required, the amount of which is set by the developer. Typically, the deposit ranges from 100,000 THB to 2% of the property price. This deposit confirms your commitment and ensures that the property you selected will be reserved for you.

Drafting, Reviewing, and Signing the Sales and Purchase Agreement

The next important step is the preparation of the main sales and purchase agreement. At this stage, the lawyers of both parties review the contract, making necessary changes and clarifications. Once everything is in order, the agreement is signed. This process can take up to 30 calendar days, depending on the conditions outlined in the reservation agreement. Signing the sales and purchase agreement legally solidifies the obligations of both parties and sets the stage for further payment actions.

After signing the main contract, it is time to make the first major payment, which usually ranges from 20% to 33% of the total property price. Further payments are made according to the schedule outlined in the reservation agreement. These can be either a lump sum payment or a series of regular payments during the construction phase.

Once the property is ready, the process of registering ownership begins. This procedure is usually handled by the developer and their legal team, although you can also appoint your independent lawyer to manage the registration. The registration process at the Land Department takes between 10 to 45 days. It is important to ensure that all documents are properly completed and registered.

After the ownership registration process is completed, you will receive a final bill for the remaining amount. Once full payment is made, you will receive documents confirming your ownership of the property. At this stage, you officially become the owner of your new home or apartment in Phuket.

Purchasing property from a developer in Thailand is a process that requires attention to detail and adherence to legal procedures. Our specialists at Get Your Phuket are ready to guide you every step of the way, ensuring the safety and success of your transaction.

What is the process for completing a property purchase from a developer in Phuket?

The process of purchasing property from a developer in Thailand can seem complex, especially if you are dealing with local legal procedures for the first time. However, by following a clear sequence of steps with a professional agency, you can safely and successfully acquire your new home or apartment in Phuket. Below are the main stages of this process.

Choosing the Right Property with an Independent Market Expert

The first step in purchasing real estate is selecting a property that meets your requirements and expectations. It is recommended to consult with an independent market expert who can help assess the prospects of various properties and provide up-to-date information about developers and the terms of the deal.

After choosing a property, you will proceed to sign a reservation agreement. It is important to carefully review the terms of the agreement, as it formalizes your intention to purchase the specific property. Along with signing the agreement, a deposit is required, the amount of which is set by the developer. Typically, the deposit ranges from 100,000 THB to 2% of the property price. This deposit confirms your commitment and ensures that the property you selected will be reserved for you.

Drafting, Reviewing, and Signing the Sales and Purchase Agreement

The next important step is the preparation of the main sales and purchase agreement. At this stage, the lawyers of both parties review the contract, making necessary changes and clarifications. Once everything is in order, the agreement is signed. This process can take up to 30 calendar days, depending on the conditions outlined in the reservation agreement. Signing the sales and purchase agreement legally solidifies the obligations of both parties and sets the stage for further payment actions.

After signing the main contract, it is time to make the first major payment, which usually ranges from 20% to 33% of the total property price. Further payments are made according to the schedule outlined in the reservation agreement. These can be either a lump sum payment or a series of regular payments during the construction phase.

Once the property is ready, the process of registering ownership begins. This procedure is usually handled by the developer and their legal team, although you can also appoint your independent lawyer to manage the registration. The registration process at the Land Department takes between 10 to 45 days. It is important to ensure that all documents are properly completed and registered.

After the ownership registration process is completed, you will receive a final bill for the remaining amount. Once full payment is made, you will receive documents confirming your ownership of the property. At this stage, you officially become the owner of your new home or apartment in Phuket.

What is the process for completing a property purchase from a developer in Phuket?

The process of purchasing property from a developer in Thailand can seem complex, especially if you are dealing with local legal procedures for the first time. However, by following a clear sequence of steps with a professional agency, you can safely and successfully acquire your new home or apartment in Phuket. Below are the main stages of this process.

Choosing the Right Property with an Independent Market Expert

The first step in purchasing real estate is selecting a property that meets your requirements and expectations. It is recommended to consult with an independent market expert who can help assess the prospects of various properties and provide up-to-date information about developers and the terms of the deal.

After choosing a property, you will proceed to sign a reservation agreement. It is important to carefully review the terms of the agreement, as it formalizes your intention to purchase the specific property. Along with signing the agreement, a deposit is required, the amount of which is set by the developer. Typically, the deposit ranges from 100,000 THB to 2% of the property price. This deposit confirms your commitment and ensures that the property you selected will be reserved for you.

Drafting, Reviewing, and Signing the Sales and Purchase Agreement

The next important step is the preparation of the main sales and purchase agreement. At this stage, the lawyers of both parties review the contract, making necessary changes and clarifications. Once everything is in order, the agreement is signed. This process can take up to 30 calendar days, depending on the conditions outlined in the reservation agreement. Signing the sales and purchase agreement legally solidifies the obligations of both parties and sets the stage for further payment actions.

After signing the main contract, it is time to make the first major payment, which usually ranges from 20% to 33% of the total property price. Further payments are made according to the schedule outlined in the reservation agreement. These can be either a lump sum payment or a series of regular payments during the construction phase.

Once the property is ready, the process of registering ownership begins. This procedure is usually handled by the developer and their legal team, although you can also appoint your independent lawyer to manage the registration. The registration process at the Land Department takes between 10 to 45 days. It is important to ensure that all documents are properly completed and registered.

After the ownership registration process is completed, you will receive a final bill for the remaining amount. Once full payment is made, you will receive documents confirming your ownership of the property. At this stage, you officially become the owner of your new home or apartment in Phuket.

Purchasing property from a developer in Thailand is a process that requires attention to detail and adherence to legal procedures. Our specialists at Get Your Phuket are ready to guide you every step of the way, ensuring the safety and success of your transaction.

What is the process for completing a property purchase from a developer in Phuket?

The process of purchasing property from a developer in Thailand can seem complex, especially if you are dealing with local legal procedures for the first time. However, by following a clear sequence of steps with a professional agency, you can safely and successfully acquire your new home or apartment in Phuket. Below are the main stages of this process.

Choosing the Right Property with an Independent Market Expert

The first step in purchasing real estate is selecting a property that meets your requirements and expectations. It is recommended to consult with an independent market expert who can help assess the prospects of various properties and provide up-to-date information about developers and the terms of the deal.

After choosing a property, you will proceed to sign a reservation agreement. It is important to carefully review the terms of the agreement, as it formalizes your intention to purchase the specific property. Along with signing the agreement, a deposit is required, the amount of which is set by the developer. Typically, the deposit ranges from 100,000 THB to 2% of the property price. This deposit confirms your commitment and ensures that the property you selected will be reserved for you.

Drafting, Reviewing, and Signing the Sales and Purchase Agreement

The next important step is the preparation of the main sales and purchase agreement. At this stage, the lawyers of both parties review the contract, making necessary changes and clarifications. Once everything is in order, the agreement is signed. This process can take up to 30 calendar days, depending on the conditions outlined in the reservation agreement. Signing the sales and purchase agreement legally solidifies the obligations of both parties and sets the stage for further payment actions.

After signing the main contract, it is time to make the first major payment, which usually ranges from 20% to 33% of the total property price. Further payments are made according to the schedule outlined in the reservation agreement. These can be either a lump sum payment or a series of regular payments during the construction phase.

Once the property is ready, the process of registering ownership begins. This procedure is usually handled by the developer and their legal team, although you can also appoint your independent lawyer to manage the registration. The registration process at the Land Department takes between 10 to 45 days. It is important to ensure that all documents are properly completed and registered.

description:
Gardens of Eden is a private resort 50 meters from Bang Tao Beach, where 70% of the territory is dedicated to parks, gardens, lakes, and public spaces, including its own 5-hectare park and 3.5 kilometers of walking trails. The concept is based on a combination of residential residences, natural landscape, and thoughtfully designed infrastructure for living, recreation, and recovery.

6 swimming pools, including the Blue Lagoon with a sandy entrance

Premium health and recovery center — featuring a thermal complex, saunas and a hammam, seawater pools at different temperatures, spa programs, a fitness club, and a medical unit. The space is complemented by wellness gardens, meditation areas, and an organic cafe.

What is the process for completing a property purchase from a developer in Phuket?

The process of purchasing property from a developer in Thailand can seem complex, especially if you are dealing with local legal procedures for the first time. However, by following a clear sequence of steps with a professional agency, you can safely and successfully acquire your new home or apartment in Phuket. Below are the main stages of this process.

Choosing the Right Property with an Independent Market Expert

The first step in purchasing real estate is selecting a property that meets your requirements and expectations. It is recommended to consult with an independent market expert who can help assess the prospects of various properties and provide up-to-date information about developers and the terms of the deal.

After choosing a property, you will proceed to sign a reservation agreement. It is important to carefully review the terms of the agreement, as it formalizes your intention to purchase the specific property. Along with signing the agreement, a deposit is required, the amount of which is set by the developer. Typically, the deposit ranges from 100,000 THB to 2% of the property price. This deposit confirms your commitment and ensures that the property you selected will be reserved for you.

Drafting, Reviewing, and Signing the Sales and Purchase Agreement

The next important step is the preparation of the main sales and purchase agreement. At this stage, the lawyers of both parties review the contract, making necessary changes and clarifications. Once everything is in order, the agreement is signed. This process can take up to 30 calendar days, depending on the conditions outlined in the reservation agreement. Signing the sales and purchase agreement legally solidifies the obligations of both parties and sets the stage for further payment actions.

After signing the main contract, it is time to make the first major payment, which usually ranges from 20% to 33% of the total property price. Further payments are made according to the schedule outlined in the reservation agreement. These can be either a lump sum payment or a series of regular payments during the construction phase.

Once the property is ready, the process of registering ownership begins. This procedure is usually handled by the developer and their legal team, although you can also appoint your independent lawyer to manage the registration. The registration process at the Land Department takes between 10 to 45 days. It is important to ensure that all documents are properly completed and registered.

After the ownership registration process is completed, you will receive a final bill for the remaining amount. Once full payment is made, you will receive documents confirming your ownership of the property. At this stage, you officially become the owner of your new home or apartment in Phuket.

Purchasing property from a developer in Thailand is a process that requires attention to detail and adherence to legal procedures. Our specialists at Get Your Phuket are ready to guide you every step of the way, ensuring the safety and success of your transaction.
