description:
Layan Lucky Villas is a luxurious residential complex consisting of 18 exclusive villas in two distinct layouts. Ideally located, the project is 20 minutes from Phuket International Airport and top international schools, and 10 minutes from Layan Beach.

The project is designed with a strong focus on functionality, security, and comfort, making it ideal for long-term living. Each villa offers a spacious layout that ensures privacy for every family member, while the outdoor areas provide multiple relaxation zones, allowing for a dynamic living experience without leaving home.

The villas are thoughtfully designed for maximum convenience. Each bedroom features a walk-in wardrobe with ample storage. There is also a spacious covered garage complemented by a separate laundry/storage area, a living room with pool and garden views, a dining area, an open-plan kitchen, and an outdoor lounge area. High-quality technical equipment is a priority, and each villa is ready for smart home system installation.

The villas feature multifunctional rooms that can be transformed into a home theater, office, gym, or spa.

The villas are located in a gated community with 24/7 security and modern systems. Even when you are far from home, you can always access the security cameras via your smartphone.

The complex is a small village surrounded by tropical nature, providing peace and privacy. The neighbors in this community are people who share similar values and lifestyles.

The villas are equipped with the latest technologies, including a Sonos audio system, high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the property, wireless chargers, video intercom, and automated modern household appliances.

If you want to add a personal touch to your future home, a team of designers is at your service.

The price includes the villa, land plot, swimming pool, air conditioners, kitchen with built-in appliances, wardrobes, plumbing, integrated "Smart Home" system, and landscape design.

name: Layan — Tri Vananda · Villa · Nanda 3 · 3 bedroom
description:
Tri Vananda is a large residential project in Phuket focused on health and well-being, developed by Montara Hospitality Group, the owner and operator of the luxurious Trisara resort on Phuket.

Size: Tri Vananda spans across 96 hectares, with only 15% of the land being used for construction.

Sustainability: The project emphasizes sustainable development and integration with nature.

Main Feature: A Health Resort by the world-renowned Clinique La Prairie, specializing in integrative and functional medicine, cognitive health, and mental well-being. The resort will be equipped with consultation rooms, physiotherapy facilities, and traditional Chinese medicine clinics.

Other Amenities: The complex includes a meditation center, a spa with thermal zones, a fitness center with a 50-meter swimming pool, and a pier for water sports.

Restaurant: JAMPA, awarded the Green Michelin Star for its commitment to sustainability, offers dishes made from seasonal products grown on the project’s own farm or sourced from local producers.

Community Center: A venue for events and socializing among residents.

Children’s Space: Includes the Tweenie Club, designed for children aged 8 to 14, with opportunities for both learning and play.

Wellness Facilities: A swimming pool, a modern gym, and various wellness offerings to promote physical health and well-being.

Exclusive Access: Owners will also have access to the services and beach at the Trisara resort.

Customizable Villas: Residents can choose the location of their villa and customize the floor plan. Seven different villa layouts are available, ranging from 2 to 4 bedrooms and from 325 m² to 853 m² in size.

Phase 1 Villas: The first phase of Tri Vananda’s residential villas is available for investment. With the opening of the Health Resort by Clinique La Prairie in 2026, demand for these exclusive villas is expected to grow. By reserving a plot now, you can secure your participation in this exceptional project.

Proximity: Just 15 minutes from Phuket International Airport and a few minutes from pristine beaches, a marina, a national park, shopping malls, UWC International School, and a hospital.

Natural Surroundings: The project is surrounded by forests and lakes, harmoniously blending with nature, promoting a peaceful and healthy living environment.

On-site Wellness Services: Modern health and wellness facilities directly within the project.

Farming: Organic farming and educational programs for children.

Community: A community of like-minded individuals supporting healthy living and mutual assistance among residents.

Sustainability: An innovative approach with renewable energy sources and water purification systems.

Ideal Location: Close to nature yet conveniently located near urban amenities.

What is the process for completing a property purchase from a developer in Phuket?

The process of purchasing property from a developer in Thailand can seem complex, especially if you are dealing with local legal procedures for the first time. However, by following a clear sequence of steps with a professional agency, you can safely and successfully acquire your new home or apartment in Phuket. Below are the main stages of this process.

Choosing the Right Property with an Independent Market Expert

The first step in purchasing real estate is selecting a property that meets your requirements and expectations. It is recommended to consult with an independent market expert who can help assess the prospects of various properties and provide up-to-date information about developers and the terms of the deal.

After choosing a property, you will proceed to sign a reservation agreement. It is important to carefully review the terms of the agreement, as it formalizes your intention to purchase the specific property. Along with signing the agreement, a deposit is required, the amount of which is set by the developer. Typically, the deposit ranges from 100,000 THB to 2% of the property price. This deposit confirms your commitment and ensures that the property you selected will be reserved for you.

Drafting, Reviewing, and Signing the Sales and Purchase Agreement

The next important step is the preparation of the main sales and purchase agreement. At this stage, the lawyers of both parties review the contract, making necessary changes and clarifications. Once everything is in order, the agreement is signed. This process can take up to 30 calendar days, depending on the conditions outlined in the reservation agreement. Signing the sales and purchase agreement legally solidifies the obligations of both parties and sets the stage for further payment actions.

After signing the main contract, it is time to make the first major payment, which usually ranges from 20% to 33% of the total property price. Further payments are made according to the schedule outlined in the reservation agreement. These can be either a lump sum payment or a series of regular payments during the construction phase.

Once the property is ready, the process of registering ownership begins. This procedure is usually handled by the developer and their legal team, although you can also appoint your independent lawyer to manage the registration. The registration process at the Land Department takes between 10 to 45 days. It is important to ensure that all documents are properly completed and registered.

After the ownership registration process is completed, you will receive a final bill for the remaining amount. Once full payment is made, you will receive documents confirming your ownership of the property. At this stage, you officially become the owner of your new home or apartment in Phuket.

Purchasing property from a developer in Thailand is a process that requires attention to detail and adherence to legal procedures. Our specialists at Get Your Phuket are ready to guide you every step of the way, ensuring the safety and success of your transaction.

What sets this project apart is that the villas do not follow standard layouts but are built to custom designs. Within just 5 minutes, residents can reach Bang Tao Beach and access the resort’s extensive amenities.

The complex is located in the prestigious Laguna Phuket area, close to the beach, golf course, and the full infrastructure of the resort.

Residents can enjoy all the resort's amenities, including restaurants, shops, spas, fitness centers, and other services, with added privileges.

A shuttle bus regularly runs between the complex and the beach, restaurants, and shops.

24-hour security, management services, and technical support ensure comfort and safety.

Laguna Homes is set in a quiet, picturesque location where owners can enjoy privacy without sacrificing the conveniences of city life.

A unique, brand-new villa with 5 spacious bedrooms and a total area of 1300 sqm is available for resale.

First Floor: The master bedroom features a walk-in closet and additional access to the garden, where an outdoor bathroom with a shower and sauna is located. There is also a panoramic office on this floor.

Second Floor: The second master bedroom, a beauty space with a massage table, an open yoga zone with views of the golf course, a large gym, and a panoramic game area with a pool table and air hockey are all situated here.

The villa includes two kitchens, a barbecue area, and large wine refrigerators.

The villa’s grounds feature an 85 sqm pool, reinforced pond banks, and a wide walking promenade that runs along the perimeter of the house.

The house is equipped with premium appliances, including brands like Smeg, Liebherr, and Dyson, as well as a smart home system, automatic irrigation, electric vehicle charging station, and a spacious garage for two cars and a motorcycle.

The interior is finished with natural materials and is filled with modern art pieces. By purchasing this home, you’re not just acquiring property, but also a lifestyle, along with exclusive privileges as a resident of one of the most prestigious resorts in Asia.

Final settlement with the seller upon signing all agreements

What is the process for completing a property purchase from a developer in Phuket?

The process of purchasing property from a developer in Thailand can seem complex, especially if you are dealing with local legal procedures for the first time. However, by following a clear sequence of steps with a professional agency, you can safely and successfully acquire your new home or apartment in Phuket. Below are the main stages of this process.

Choosing the Right Property with an Independent Market Expert

The first step in purchasing real estate is selecting a property that meets your requirements and expectations. It is recommended to consult with an independent market expert who can help assess the prospects of various properties and provide up-to-date information about developers and the terms of the deal.

After choosing a property, you will proceed to sign a reservation agreement. It is important to carefully review the terms of the agreement, as it formalizes your intention to purchase the specific property. Along with signing the agreement, a deposit is required, the amount of which is set by the developer. Typically, the deposit ranges from 100,000 THB to 2% of the property price. This deposit confirms your commitment and ensures that the property you selected will be reserved for you.

Drafting, Reviewing, and Signing the Sales and Purchase Agreement

The next important step is the preparation of the main sales and purchase agreement. At this stage, the lawyers of both parties review the contract, making necessary changes and clarifications. Once everything is in order, the agreement is signed. This process can take up to 30 calendar days, depending on the conditions outlined in the reservation agreement. Signing the sales and purchase agreement legally solidifies the obligations of both parties and sets the stage for further payment actions.

After signing the main contract, it is time to make the first major payment, which usually ranges from 20% to 33% of the total property price. Further payments are made according to the schedule outlined in the reservation agreement. These can be either a lump sum payment or a series of regular payments during the construction phase.

Once the property is ready, the process of registering ownership begins. This procedure is usually handled by the developer and their legal team, although you can also appoint your independent lawyer to manage the registration. The registration process at the Land Department takes between 10 to 45 days. It is important to ensure that all documents are properly completed and registered.

After the ownership registration process is completed, you will receive a final bill for the remaining amount. Once full payment is made, you will receive documents confirming your ownership of the property. At this stage, you officially become the owner of your new home or apartment in Phuket.

Purchasing property from a developer in Thailand is a process that requires attention to detail and adherence to legal procedures. Our specialists at Get Your Phuket are ready to guide you every step of the way, ensuring the safety and success of your transaction.

What is the process for completing a property purchase from a developer in Phuket?

The process of purchasing property from a developer in Thailand can seem complex, especially if you are dealing with local legal procedures for the first time. However, by following a clear sequence of steps with a professional agency, you can safely and successfully acquire your new home or apartment in Phuket. Below are the main stages of this process.

Choosing the Right Property with an Independent Market Expert

The first step in purchasing real estate is selecting a property that meets your requirements and expectations. It is recommended to consult with an independent market expert who can help assess the prospects of various properties and provide up-to-date information about developers and the terms of the deal.

After choosing a property, you will proceed to sign a reservation agreement. It is important to carefully review the terms of the agreement, as it formalizes your intention to purchase the specific property. Along with signing the agreement, a deposit is required, the amount of which is set by the developer. Typically, the deposit ranges from 100,000 THB to 2% of the property price. This deposit confirms your commitment and ensures that the property you selected will be reserved for you.

Drafting, Reviewing, and Signing the Sales and Purchase Agreement

The next important step is the preparation of the main sales and purchase agreement. At this stage, the lawyers of both parties review the contract, making necessary changes and clarifications. Once everything is in order, the agreement is signed. This process can take up to 30 calendar days, depending on the conditions outlined in the reservation agreement. Signing the sales and purchase agreement legally solidifies the obligations of both parties and sets the stage for further payment actions.

After signing the main contract, it is time to make the first major payment, which usually ranges from 20% to 33% of the total property price. Further payments are made according to the schedule outlined in the reservation agreement. These can be either a lump sum payment or a series of regular payments during the construction phase.

Once the property is ready, the process of registering ownership begins. This procedure is usually handled by the developer and their legal team, although you can also appoint your independent lawyer to manage the registration. The registration process at the Land Department takes between 10 to 45 days. It is important to ensure that all documents are properly completed and registered.

What is the process for completing a property purchase from a developer in Phuket?

The process of purchasing property from a developer in Thailand can seem complex, especially if you are dealing with local legal procedures for the first time. However, by following a clear sequence of steps with a professional agency, you can safely and successfully acquire your new home or apartment in Phuket. Below are the main stages of this process.

Choosing the Right Property with an Independent Market Expert

The first step in purchasing real estate is selecting a property that meets your requirements and expectations. It is recommended to consult with an independent market expert who can help assess the prospects of various properties and provide up-to-date information about developers and the terms of the deal.

After choosing a property, you will proceed to sign a reservation agreement. It is important to carefully review the terms of the agreement, as it formalizes your intention to purchase the specific property. Along with signing the agreement, a deposit is required, the amount of which is set by the developer. Typically, the deposit ranges from 100,000 THB to 2% of the property price. This deposit confirms your commitment and ensures that the property you selected will be reserved for you.

Drafting, Reviewing, and Signing the Sales and Purchase Agreement

The next important step is the preparation of the main sales and purchase agreement. At this stage, the lawyers of both parties review the contract, making necessary changes and clarifications. Once everything is in order, the agreement is signed. This process can take up to 30 calendar days, depending on the conditions outlined in the reservation agreement. Signing the sales and purchase agreement legally solidifies the obligations of both parties and sets the stage for further payment actions.

After signing the main contract, it is time to make the first major payment, which usually ranges from 20% to 33% of the total property price. Further payments are made according to the schedule outlined in the reservation agreement. These can be either a lump sum payment or a series of regular payments during the construction phase.

Once the property is ready, the process of registering ownership begins. This procedure is usually handled by the developer and their legal team, although you can also appoint your independent lawyer to manage the registration. The registration process at the Land Department takes between 10 to 45 days. It is important to ensure that all documents are properly completed and registered.

After the ownership registration process is completed, you will receive a final bill for the remaining amount. Once full payment is made, you will receive documents confirming your ownership of the property. At this stage, you officially become the owner of your new home or apartment in Phuket.

Purchasing property from a developer in Thailand is a process that requires attention to detail and adherence to legal procedures. Our specialists at Get Your Phuket are ready to guide you every step of the way, ensuring the safety and success of your transaction.

The Allamanda is the first apart-hotel to be built in the heart of Laguna Phuket Resort in 2009 and is still a favourite destination for expats and Phuket guests. The Allamanda complex consists of three three-storey buildings: Allamanda 1 is facing the sea and the fresh lake and Allamanda 2 and 3, which with all its windows overlooks the luxurious Laguna Golf course. Allamanda guests and residents can take advantage of the entire infrastructure of the huge Laguna Phuket Resort, receiving privileges in the form of discounts at the restaurants, spas and boutiques of the resort. Allamanda has 4 types of apartments: studios, one-bedroom, two-bedroom and three-story duplexes. In total, the project has 115 spacious apartments ranging from 65 to 140 m2. Allamanda attracts golf loving amateurs and professionals from all over the world.

Allamanda has its own bar, reception, two communal swimming pools with sun loungers and showers, minimart, walking paths. A free shuttle bus runs regularly from the complex to the beach and back. While resting in Allamanda, you do not need to rent transport - you can get to any point of the resort by shuttle bus. This is especially convenient for families with small children.

Allamanda Complex is located just a 5-10 minute walk from Bangtao Beach. This beach is where Phuket's most popular beach clubs are located, such as Xana Beach Club, Dream Beach Club and Catch Club. Laguna Phuket Golf Club is next to Allamanda and hosts international tournaments. Inexperienced golfers can use the services of a personal golf coach. A 5-minute drive from Allamanda is the Boat Avenue shopping complex with a variety of shops, countless restaurants and bars, and a European supermarket Villa Market. The modern Porto De Phuket shopping complex, with countless restaurants, Tors supermarket, boutiques and food court, is just a short drive away. Nearby is the Lemonade Kids Club with a children's room and a pool for children, a hot sauna for adults. The bustling party scene of Patong is a 30-minute drive from the complex. The road from the airport to the complex will take about 25 minutes.

Allamanda is located in one of the most prestigious areas of Phuket with developed infrastructure, but the cost of housing is relatively low. Therefore, the project is suitable for all those who prefer a measured rest surrounded by beautiful landscapes to a noisy crowd of tourists. Allamanda is loved by everyone, from young families with children to people of venerable age. description:
1-Bedroom Apartments, with golf course in Allamanda 2 and 3 project, on Bangtao/Laguna beach | Video

The Allamanda Hotel is located just 5 minutes from the beautiful Bang Tao Beach, in the northern part of the island within the world-renowned 5-star Laguna resort complex, home to the Dusit Thani, Banyan Tree, and Angsana hotels. A free shuttle bus runs throughout the day, and a charming boat sails across the scenic lake, delivering you directly to the shore. Nearby, you'll find a large Villa Market supermarket, a night market, spa salons, and restaurants to suit every taste.

The Allamanda Hotel is located just 5 minutes from the beautiful Bang Tao Beach, in the northern part of the island within the world-renowned 5-star Laguna resort complex, home to the Dusit Thani, Banyan Tree, and Angsana hotels. A free shuttle bus runs throughout the day, and a charming boat sails across the scenic lake, delivering you directly to the shore. Nearby, you'll find a large Villa Market supermarket, a night market, spa salons, and restaurants to suit every taste.

The apartments are cozy and spacious, and from the living room, you can take a stroll to the pool or along the charming pathways. If you’re used to comfort, this is the perfect apartment for you. Guests have access to a living room combined with a kitchen area.

A direct walking route to the beach through the stunning Angsana Hotel takes no more than 5 minutes.

The Allamanda is the first apart-hotel to be built in the heart of Laguna Phuket Resort in 2009 and is still a favourite destination for expats and Phuket guests. The Allamanda complex consists of three three-storey buildings: Allamanda 1 is facing the sea and the fresh lake and Allamanda 2 and 3, which with all its windows overlooks the luxurious Laguna Golf course. Allamanda guests and residents can take advantage of the entire infrastructure of the huge Laguna Phuket Resort, receiving privileges in the form of discounts at the restaurants, spas and boutiques of the resort. Allamanda has 4 types of apartments: studios, one-bedroom, two-bedroom and three-story duplexes. In total, the project has 115 spacious apartments ranging from 65 to 140 m2. Allamanda attracts golf loving amateurs and professionals from all over the world.

Allamanda has its own bar, reception, two communal swimming pools with sun loungers and showers, minimart, walking paths. A free shuttle bus runs regularly from the complex to the beach and back. While resting in Allamanda, you do not need to rent transport - you can get to any point of the resort by shuttle bus. This is especially convenient for families with small children.

Allamanda Complex is located just a 5-10 minute walk from Bangtao Beach. This beach is where Phuket's most popular beach clubs are located, such as Xana Beach Club, Dream Beach Club and Catch Club. Laguna Phuket Golf Club is next to Allamanda and hosts international tournaments. Inexperienced golfers can use the services of a personal golf coach. A 5-minute drive from Allamanda is the Boat Avenue shopping complex with a variety of shops, countless restaurants and bars, and a European supermarket Villa Market. The modern Porto De Phuket shopping complex, with countless restaurants, Tors supermarket, boutiques and food court, is just a short drive away. Nearby is the Lemonade Kids Club with a children's room and a pool for children, a hot sauna for adults. The bustling party scene of Patong is a 30-minute drive from the complex. The road from the airport to the complex will take about 25 minutes.

Allamanda is located in one of the most prestigious areas of Phuket with developed infrastructure, but the cost of housing is relatively low. Therefore, the project is suitable for all those who prefer a measured rest surrounded by beautiful landscapes to a noisy crowd of tourists. Allamanda is loved by everyone, from young families with children to people of venerable age. Whether you rent or purchase a property in Laguna Phuket, you and your home acquire the style, lifestyle and privileges of a resident of the most prestigious Asian resort.

It offers 1 bedroom. Total area is 83 m². The sea is approximately 800 m away. The unit is part of Allamanda 2 and 3 .

Lake Residences is the third phase of the large-scale Gardens of Eden development in the Layan–Bang Tao area of Phuket. Created by Amal Development with architecture and landscape design by Tierra Design and Wonder by White Jacket, the project is built around a strong nature-focused and wellness-driven philosophy. Lake Residences is set along a scenic lake within the masterplan and offers a calm, park-like environment with extensive greenery, water features, and low building density. This phase consists of nine residential buildings with a total of 698 units, all positioned around the lake with a 150-metre pool and approximately 5,000 square metres of water surface, including areas with colorful fish. The development features underground parking with elevator access, keeping the internal spaces peaceful and free from traffic.

Gardens of Eden places a strong emphasis on lifestyle and wellbeing. Around 70% of the entire land area is dedicated to open green spaces, landscaped gardens, and recreational zones. Residents will have access to a wide range of facilities, including a large wellness center of about 5,000 square metres, multiple jogging and walking trails totaling 3.5 kilometres, kids’ play areas and clubs, two clubhouses, an open-air cinema, a pet park, several on-site restaurants, a business center, and a small supermarket. The broader development also incorporates an 80-room hotel, adding to the overall convenience and service level. Materials, design elements, and landscaping throughout the project follow a biophilic, eco-minded approach with a focus on natural materials and an abundance of greenery.

Lake Residences offers units on a long-term leasehold basis with a 90-year structure, while freehold ownership is available by request for an additional cost. Furniture packages are provided separately. Completion for this phase is targeted for the third quarter of 2028. Since it is an off-plan development, buyers should consider typical construction and delivery risks, along with the leasehold structure and long investment horizon. Despite this, the project stands out for its large scale, wellness concept, extensive facilities, and rare amount of natural open space, making it appealing for both long-term living and high-end resort-style use.

It offers 1 bedroom. Total area is 52 m². The sea is approximately 501 m away. The unit is part of Lake Residences by Gardens of Eden .

The Residences at InterContinental Phuket Resort is an exclusive collection of luxury residences set on the prestigious beachfront of Kamala, designed for those who value tranquility, privacy, and world-class service. The project blends the prestige of the InterContinental brand with contemporary tropical architecture and the ambiance of a high-end resort. With only 111 residences across two elegant low-rise buildings, the development offers a truly private, low-density environment where every detail has been carefully curated for exceptional comfort. The residence selection includes a wide range of layouts: from one-bedroom units sized 59–68 sqm and corner 1-Bedroom layouts of 58–76 sqm, to spacious two-bedroom residences of 100–134 sqm, including exclusive two-bedroom units with private pools ranging from 169–188 sqm. For those who desire generous living space, the project offers refined three-bedroom units of 203–215 sqm, sophisticated 4-Bedroom Junior Penthouses of around 201 sqm, and a magnificent five-bedroom penthouse measuring 425 sqm — the pinnacle of privacy, elegance, and luxury living.

Residents enjoy access to an extensive array of resort-level amenities: multiple swimming pools, including hydro-therapy and dedicated children’s pools, a state-of-the-art fitness center, yoga and meditation decks, expansive landscaped gardens, serene lounge areas, shaded pavilions, and a curated selection of family and children’s spaces such as playrooms, a library, and co-kitchen zones. Enhancing the everyday experience, InterContinental-standard services — concierge, housekeeping, spa, and dining — provide the comfort and convenience of a five-star hotel within the privacy of your own home.

Construction of the project is already underway, with official completion and handover scheduled for Q3 2027, offering buyers the opportunity to secure a future-ready residence delivered fully finished and aligned with the exceptional standards promised by the development.

The Residences at InterContinental Phuket Resort presents a rare opportunity to own an exclusive beachfront home in one of Phuket’s most desirable locations. Perfect for those seeking privacy, exceptional service, sophisticated architecture, and a true resort-style living experience — whether as a permanent residence, a holiday home, or a luxury family retreat by the sea.

Kamala combines a relaxed residential atmosphere with quick access to beach clubs, restaurants and the west coast infrastructure. It is a strong choice for lifestyle buyers and rental investors.

It offers 1 bedroom. Total area is 67 m². The sea is approximately 701 m away. The unit is part of The Residences at InterContinental Phuket Resort.

AURA Condominium is a modern and luxurious residential complex located in the heart of Rawai, Phuket. The project consists of two seven-story buildings, offering a total of 241 fully furnished and equipped apartments to suit every lifestyle. From Superior Studios to spacious Three-Bedroom units, the sizes range from 29.23 sqm to 96.07 sqm.

The exterior of AURA Condominium showcases a sleek, contemporary design with curved buildings and expansive glass windows. Beaches: Rawai Beach (9 minutes), Naiharn Beach (12 minutes), Kata Beach (13 minutes).

Shopping: Villa Market (6 minutes), Robinson (8 minutes), Central Phuket Festival (15 minutes).

Outdoors, residents can enjoy three zoned swimming pools, a dedicated children’s playground, and secure parking for up to 99 cars.

Allamanda is the first apart-hotel to be built in the heart of Laguna Phuket Resort in 2000 and is still a favourite destination for expats and guests of Phuket. The Allamanda complex consists of three three-storey buildings: Allamanda 1 is facing the sea and the fresh lake and Allamanda 2 and 3, which with all its windows overlooks the luxurious Laguna Golf course. Allamanda guests and residents can take advantage of the entire infrastructure of the huge Laguna Phuket Resort, receiving privileges in the form of discounts at the restaurants, spas and boutiques of the resort. Allamanda has 4 types of apartments: studios, one-bedroom, two-bedroom and three-story duplexes. In total, the project has 115 spacious apartments ranging from 65 to 140 m2. Allamanda attracts golf amateurs and professionals from all over the world.

Allamanda has its own bar, reception, two communal swimming pools with sun loungers and showers, minimart, walking paths. A free shuttle bus runs regularly from the complex to the beach and back. While resting in Allamanda, you do not need to rent transport - you can get to any point of the resort by shuttle bus. This is especially convenient for families with small children.

Allamanda Complex is located just a 5-10 minute walk from Bangtao Beach. This beach is where Phuket's most popular beach clubs are located, such as Xana Beach Club, Dream Beach Club and Catch Club. Laguna Phuket Golf Club is next to Allamanda and hosts international tournaments. Inexperienced golfers can use the services of a personal golf coach. A 5-minute drive from Allamanda is the Boat Avenue shopping complex with a variety of shops, countless restaurants and bars, and a European supermarket Villa Market. The modern Porto De Phuket shopping complex, with countless restaurants, Tors supermarket, boutiques and food court, is just a short drive away. Nearby is the Lemonade Kids Club with a children's room and a pool for children, a hot sauna for adults. The bustling party scene of Patong is a 30-minute drive from the complex. The road from the airport to the complex will take about 25 minutes.

Allamanda is located in one of the most prestigious areas of Phuket with developed infrastructure, but the cost of housing is relatively low. Therefore, the project is suitable for all those who prefer a measured rest surrounded by beautiful landscapes to a noisy crowd of tourists. Allamanda is loved by everyone, from young families with children to people of venerable age. Whether you rent or purchase a property in Laguna Phuket, you and your home acquire the style, lifestyle and privileges of a resident of the most prestigious Asian resort.

Enjoy an extraordinary getaway on the island of Phuket! By purchasing these apartments, you gain privacy, first-class amenities, independence, and excellent value for money.

Enjoy an extraordinary getaway on the island of Phuket! By purchasing these apartments, you gain privacy, first-class amenities, independence, and excellent value for money.

The complex is located on Phuket’s west coast within the Ocean Breeze hotel, perched on the hillside of Cape Layan, with easy access to Bang Tao and Layan, known for their pristine and untouched beaches.

This low-rise residential apartment complex is designed in a tropical style. Its buildings artfully evoke images of a bygone, more tranquil era. Six beautiful colonial-style houses are spread around a stunning lake and an impressive pool with a cascading waterfall. The pristine white buildings are nestled within lush exotic gardens—a paradise rich with birds, flowers, white lilies, and fragrant jasmine trees. Plus, the beach is just a leisurely few minutes’ walk away!

The relaxing and cozy living room is adorned with Thai silk, cotton, and wood; the modern, fully equipped Western kitchen and the bedroom feature a large double bed and an en-suite bathroom with both a bathtub and a shower. French doors open from the bedroom onto a spacious 12 m² veranda, furnished with a comfortable sofa and a dining area for five. From the veranda, you can enjoy picturesque views of the mountains, pool, and lake.

Thanks to the exquisite and timeless design of this place, its lush gardens bursting with exotic blooms, top-notch service, convenient location, outstanding value, and genuine privacy, these apartments will captivate anyone seeking a unique and personalized retreat in Thailand.

Ocean Breeze is an award-winning complex that was built in 2006 and is still a favourite destination for expats and visitors to Phuket today. The complex consists of three-storey buildings surrounded by a lake and pool. Ocean Breeze has 3 types of apartments: studios, one and two-bedroom units. All apartments overlook a picturesque garden, pool and lake. There are 50 spacious apartments in the project. With its delightful and timeless design, lush gardens glowing with exotic flowers, first-class service, convenient location, great value for money and genuine privacy, this apartment will enchant anyone looking for a unique, personalised holiday in Thailand.

The Ocean Breeze has a communal swimming pool with sun loungers and showers, a gym and walking paths. You can get to the beach by rented motorbike or car and it only takes 5 minutes.

Ocean Breeze is located just a 5-minute drive from Bangtao Beach. This beach is where Phuket's most popular beach clubs are located, such as Xana Beach Club, Dream Beach Club and Catch Club. The nearby Laguna Phuket Golf Club hosts international tournaments. Inexperienced golfers can use the services of a personal golf coach. A 10-minute drive from the complex is the Boat Avenue shopping complex with many shops, countless restaurants and bars, Villa Market supermarket of European products. The modern Porto De Phuket shopping complex, with countless restaurants, Tors supermarket, boutiques and food court, is just a short drive away. Nearby is the Lemonade Kids Club with a children's room and a pool for children, a hot sauna for adults. The bustling party scene of Patong is a 30-minute drive from the complex. The road from the airport to the complex will take about 25 minutes.

Ocean Breeze is located in one of the most prestigious areas of Phuket with developed infrastructure, but the cost of housing is relatively low. Therefore, the project is suitable for all those who prefer a measured rest surrounded by beautiful landscapes.

It offers 1 bedroom. Total area is 76 m². The sea is approximately 1,200 m away. The unit is part of Ocean Breeze .

An excellent residential complex on the island of Phuket. Located directly on the first line of Rawai Beach, just 60 meters from the sea. It consists of seven 4-story residential buildings, each with forty apartments. The complex features two swimming pools, a garden, and an artificial waterfall. This is a great investment both for living and for investment purposes. A truly stunning project in a cozy location on Rawai Beach, designed in accordance with the island’s ecological requirements, so the common area adjacent to the condominium will be filled with greenery, gardens, pools, and even a waterfall.

The one-bedroom apartments, measuring 35 m², include a living room and a bedroom with an adjoining bathroom, a small kitchen with a dining area, and a terrace.

The price includes built-in furniture (kitchen, wardrobes), bathroom fixtures and plumbing, and curtains.

The complex is a 10-minute drive from shopping centers, hospitals, and the city center. Nearby, you’ll find mini-markets, bars, restaurants, and spa salons, as well as a fish market where you can always buy freshly caught fish and shrimp. One of the main advantages of this project is the possibility of obtaining full ownership of the property. Construction completion is scheduled for December 2013.

The Title V condominium will be located at the southernmost point of Phuket Island. 20 meters from the popular Rawai promenade and in the very centre of the developed tourist infrastructure of the southern part of the island. The first phase was commissioned in 2016, it consists of 7 buildings with elevators of 4 floors, the second phase is absolutely identical in architecture, it differs only in the year of construction, it is newer - it was commissioned in 2018. A recognizable feature of the project is the landscape design, families with children fell in love with this place for the green area and large swimming pools with a children's area, as well as for the opportunity for children to play completely safely on the territory of the complex and be absolutely calm for their safety, because the territory is guarded 24 hours a day. Young couples choose it for its privacy and the opportunity to spend romantic evenings in small restaurants on the seashore, which are located across the street from the complex. Elderly couples appreciate the incredibly comfortable conditions and the level of service, as well as the opportunity to get literally in a matter of minutes to the neighbouring Naiharn beach to swim and sunbathe on the white sand. Young guys and girls for the opportunity to make morning and evening jogging along the wide embankment in the shade of trees and for yoga classes right on the seashore, and in the evening for the opportunity to relax in one of the spa salons, which are located right next to the complex. And of course, everyone who loves to have fun fell in love with this place because there are numerous bars and restaurants within walking distance of the fish market, famous throughout Phuket.

On the territory of the project there will be a large and well-groomed green area with communal pools with a special children's area, as well as a sauna, reception and 24-hour security and parking.

Studio apartments, 1 bedroom and 2-bedroom apartments with balcony or garden access, which have bedrooms, living room with TV, fully equipped kitchen, where you will find everything you need: dishes, refrigerator, kettle and microwave and balcony.

The complex is located 2 km from the observation deck "Windmill" and in km from Cape Promtep. Phuket Seashell Museum is 2.8 km away. Phuket International Airport is 49 km away.

One of the best beaches - Naiharn is located 4 kilometres from the project. The beach is popular with families with children and expats, so you will not find a large crowd of tourists here. A stone's throw from the beach, there is a freshwater lake and an observation deck with windmills. Naiharn Beach is popular with families with children, as well as with winterers and long-livers of the island. It is comfortable to spend your holiday here, because Nearby there are many restaurants like European. So is the national Thai cuisine. There are also offices with transport rental and excursion services. For a long stay on Naiharn, it is comfortable to live for families with children - there are international and Thai kindergartens, international and Russian schools nearby. The way from Naiharn to the popular children's play complex "Rawai Park" will take 5 minutes by car or bike.

Naiharn is also often chosen for yoga tours or sports camping. At Naiharn and in the neighbouring Rawai district, there are gyms, specialized rings for Thai boxing and workout grounds. Within a 7-10 minute drive there is a Macro hypermarket, a supermarket with European products Villa Market, a fish market.

The apartments in the project are available for both short vacations and long term rentals. Most often this complex is chosen by expats and winterers, especially young and elderly couples, as well as families with children.

Allamanda guests and residents can take advantage of the entire infrastructure of the huge Laguna Phuket Resort, receiving privileges in the form of discounts at the restaurants, spas and boutiques of the resort. Lake Residences is the third phase of the large-scale Gardens of Eden development in the Layan–Bang Tao area of Phuket. Created by Amal Development with architecture and landscape design by Tierra Design and Wonder by White Jacket, the project is built around a strong nature-focused and wellness-driven philosophy. Lake Residences is set along a scenic lake within the masterplan and offers a calm, park-like environment with extensive greenery, water features, and low building density. This phase consists of nine residential buildings with a total of 698 units, all positioned around the lake with a 150-metre pool and approximately 5,000 square metres of water surface, including areas with colorful fish. The development features underground parking with elevator access, keeping the internal spaces peaceful and free from traffic.

Gardens of Eden places a strong emphasis on lifestyle and wellbeing. Around 70% of the entire land area is dedicated to open green spaces, landscaped gardens, and recreational zones. Residents will have access to a wide range of facilities, including a large wellness center of about 5,000 square metres, multiple jogging and walking trails totaling 3.5 kilometres, kids’ play areas and clubs, two clubhouses, an open-air cinema, a pet park, several on-site restaurants, a business center, and a small supermarket. The broader development also incorporates an 80-room hotel, adding to the overall convenience and service level. Materials, design elements, and landscaping throughout the project follow a biophilic, eco-minded approach with a focus on natural materials and an abundance of greenery.

Lake Residences offers units on a long-term leasehold basis with a 90-year structure, while freehold ownership is available by request for an additional cost. Furniture packages are provided separately. Completion for this phase is targeted for the third quarter of 2028. Since it is an off-plan development, buyers should consider typical construction and delivery risks, along with the leasehold structure and long investment horizon. Despite this, the project stands out for its large scale, wellness concept, extensive facilities, and rare amount of natural open space, making it appealing for both long-term living and high-end resort-style use.
specs: Lake Residences by Gardens of Eden

Six beautiful colonial-style houses are spread around a stunning lake and an impressive pool with a cascading waterfall. The pristine white buildings are immersed in lush exotic gardens—a paradise rich with birds and flowers, white lilies, and fragrant jasmine trees. Plus, the beach is just a few leisurely minutes’ walk away!

The relaxing and cozy living room is decorated with Thai silk, cotton, and wood; the modern, fully equipped Western kitchen and bedroom feature a large double bed and an en-suite bathroom with both a bathtub and a shower. French doors open from the bedroom onto a spacious 24 m² veranda, furnished with a comfortable sofa and a dining area for five. From the veranda, you can enjoy picturesque views of the mountains, pool, and lake.

Thanks to the delightful and timeless design of this property, lush gardens bursting with exotic blooms, top-notch service, convenient location, excellent value, and genuine privacy, these apartments will captivate anyone seeking a unique and personalized retreat in Thailand.

Ocean Breeze is an award-winning complex that was built in 2006 and is still a favourite destination for expats and visitors to Phuket today. The complex consists of three-storey buildings surrounded by a lake and pool. Ocean Breeze has 3 types of apartments: studios, one and two-bedroom units. All apartments overlook a picturesque garden, pool and lake. There are 50 spacious apartments in the project. With its delightful and timeless design, lush gardens glowing with exotic flowers, first-class service, convenient location, great value for money and genuine privacy, this apartment will enchant anyone looking for a unique, personalised holiday in Thailand.

The Ocean Breeze has a communal swimming pool with sun loungers and showers, a gym and walking paths. You can get to the beach by rented motorbike or car and it only takes 5 minutes.

The modern Porto De Phuket shopping complex, with countless restaurants, Tors supermarket, boutiques and food court, is just a short drive away. Nearby is the Lemonade Kids Club with a children's room and a pool for children, a hot sauna for adults. The bustling party scene of Patong is a 30-minute drive from the complex. The road from the airport to the complex will take about 25 minutes.

Ocean Breeze is located in one of the most prestigious areas of Phuket with developed infrastructure, but the cost of housing is relatively low. Therefore, the project is suitable for all those who prefer a measured rest surrounded by beautiful landscapes.

Cozy two-bedroom apartments in the Allamanda Laguna Phuket 4 * hotel, one of five hotels in the famous Laguna Phuket complex.

Allamanda Hotel is located literally 5 minutes from the beautiful Bangtao Beach, in the north of the island in the world famous 5 * Laguna Resort, where Dusit Thani, Banyan Tree and Angsana hotels are located. A free bus runs throughout the day, and a boat sails along the picturesque lake that will take you straight to the shore.

The apartment has a total area of ​​135 square meters, a living room and a small kitchen with a dining room, two bedrooms and two bathrooms, as well as a terrace overlooking the beautiful freshwater Lagoon, along which river trams run. The second and third floors are occupied by two bedrooms and two bathrooms.

Guests can use the communal pool and restaurant as well as all of the complex's services such as golf courses, tennis courts, gyms, kids clubs, spas, pools and beaches. Free shuttle buses run regularly throughout the area.

Allamanda is the first apart-hotel to be built in the heart of Laguna Phuket Resort in 2000 and is still a favourite destination for expats and guests of Phuket. The Allamanda complex consists of three three-storey buildings: Allamanda 1 is facing the sea and the fresh lake and Allamanda 2 and 3, which with all its windows overlooks the luxurious Laguna Golf course. Allamanda guests and residents can take advantage of the entire infrastructure of the huge Laguna Phuket Resort, receiving privileges in the form of discounts at the restaurants, spas and boutiques of the resort. Allamanda has 4 types of apartments: studios, one-bedroom, two-bedroom and three-story duplexes. In total, the project has 115 spacious apartments ranging from 65 to 140 m2. Allamanda attracts golf amateurs and professionals from all over the world.

Allamanda has its own bar, reception, two communal swimming pools with sun loungers and showers, minimart, walking paths. A free shuttle bus runs regularly from the complex to the beach and back. While resting in Allamanda, you do not need to rent transport - you can get to any point of the resort by shuttle bus. This is especially convenient for families with small children.

Allamanda Complex is located just a 5-10 minute walk from Bangtao Beach. This beach is where Phuket's most popular beach clubs are located, such as Xana Beach Club, Dream Beach Club and Catch Club. Laguna Phuket Golf Club is next to Allamanda and hosts international tournaments. Inexperienced golfers can use the services of a personal golf coach. A 5-minute drive from Allamanda is the Boat Avenue shopping complex with a variety of shops, countless restaurants and bars, and a European supermarket Villa Market. The modern Porto De Phuket shopping complex, with countless restaurants, Tors supermarket, boutiques and food court, is just a short drive away. Nearby is the Lemonade Kids Club with a children's room and a pool for children, a hot sauna for adults. The bustling party scene of Patong is a 30-minute drive from the complex. The road from the airport to the complex will take about 25 minutes.

Allamanda is located in one of the most prestigious areas of Phuket with developed infrastructure, but the cost of housing is relatively low. Therefore, the project is suitable for all those who prefer a measured rest surrounded by beautiful landscapes to a noisy crowd of tourists. Allamanda is loved by everyone, from young families with children to people of venerable age. Whether you rent or purchase a property in Laguna Phuket, you and your home acquire the style, lifestyle and privileges of a resident of the most prestigious Asian resort.

It offers 2 bedrooms. Total area is 135 m². The sea is approximately 700 m away. The unit is part of Allamanda 1.

Andara Resort is located on Kamala Beach, a 3 km stretch of beach on the west coast of Phuket. The beach is adjacent to the Andaman Sea, calm, relatively quiet time, but at the same time within easy reach of the small friendly village of Kamala.

There is a pristine beach at your doorstep, so there is no need to explore further. Kamala Beach is stunningly beautiful with crystal clear waters, white sand and gentle waves. The Millionaire Row where Andara Resort Villas can be found is an exclusive community of luxury hotels that attracts many wealthy expatriates from around the world. The entire area is dotted with private villas and hotels, resorts and signature beach clubs that are increasingly difficult to find around the world today. The area is quiet enough, but within easy reach of the friendly village of Kamala, within walking distance of the resort where you can find a wide variety of shops, restaurants, including a supermarket with everyday products. Phuket Island offers World Class, Medical Facilities, Golf Courses, Marina and Diving Centers as well as large shopping malls offering branded products.

Andara Residences provides the same luxury and lifestyle as a villa, but with more comfortable dimensions. All of these luxury gadgets have all the comforts and conveniences of a resort.

The apartments can be used as the main house or rented out by Andara management to generate rental income. In any case, these residences are the epitome of luxury apartments in the tropics.

The building, completed in 2010, has been meticulously designed and built to perfection. Its design combines five-star resort life with Thai / Balinese and contemporary architecture, with attention to detail in both home layout and building materials. The spacious open-plan villa is made up of two-story pavilions, each of which is connected by covered walkways to connect both indoor and outdoor living spaces. The interior of the house combines elements of South East Asia and modern design, an abundance of Minotti furniture and the most modern audiovisual systems, including the Sonos audio system.

Western 5-star hotels, spa with eight separate rooms, 300-area gym. .m offers a wide range of professional equipment and a 400 sqm spa pool. Each of the properties has an experienced management team that will support and meet all your needs !!

Upon completion in 2010, the villa is professionally managed by Andara Resorts staff and a local general manager.

The new owner will be able to use the same resort management team / company, select an alternative provider and / or manage the property.

Properties in the offer on a VERY LEVEL with a secured land lease structure that ensures the security of foreign ownership.

Five-star hotel Andara Resort is located on the west coast of Phuket. The hotel has 26 villas and 37 luxury apartments with magnificent sea views. Respectable interior furnished with precious rocks, walls decorated with Jim Thompson silk, Thai artifacts, candles and incense along with modern equipment create an unusually sophisticated and comfortable atmosphere for a premium holiday. The area of apartments and villas: the minimum room is 153 sq. m, the maximum is 2100 sq. m!

Andara Resort has all the infrastructure of a 5* hotel. On site, guests can relax at the Andara Spa. There is an opportunity to do a hairstyle, pedicure, manicure, etc. Lovers of steam are available free access to the sauna. Fashionable SILK restaurant, pampering guests with Thai and international dishes. In SILK you can always please yourself with a variety of dishes, and of course, there is always the opportunity to order a private dinner. For children, a fun children's menu and entertainment are offered. Children's mini-club with a games room and a playground. The animation team and educators will not let the kids get bored. The fitness center is equipped with modern simulators, power stations, equipment. To choose the right training regime will help a professional coach. Group classes are also held here. Guests can work out in the gym until 8 p.m. And if you want to practice at night, they will open it on a call. In the beach club Beach Club you can sunbathe on double sunbeds, swim or do sea sports - windsurfing, parasailing, ride a scooter, banana or catamaran. The Beach Club is a 7-minute walk or a 2-3 minute shuttle ride from the reception from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.

Phuket International Airport is located just 18 km from the hotel complex. The city centre is 20 km away. A free shuttle service to the surrounding area is available for up to 1 km. This is enough to reach the resort town of Kamala, where there are many shops, cafes, restaurants, beach clubs, such as the world-famous Cafe Del Mar, the PINE Beach Club at the Intercontinental Hotel, the HQ Beach Club. Very close (1.4 km) is the theme park Phuket Fantasea.

A place of rest for your family, friends, as a romantic oasis for your couple. All, without exception, rooms are ready to accept families with children of any age. There are rooms for non-smokers and allergy sufferers. Villas with 3-7 bedrooms are ideal for family stays, meetings of friends or for special celebrations.

Kamala combines a relaxed residential atmosphere with quick access to beach clubs, restaurants and the west coast infrastructure. It is a strong choice for lifestyle buyers and rental investors.

Angsana Laguna Phuket spreads her wings with the addition of three low-rise buildings containing 116 hotel rooms and 33 apartments in the heart of Asia’s finest integrated resort– Laguna Phuket.Operated by Angsana Laguna Phuket, the Angsana Oceanview Residences provide a unique and attractive lifestyle investment for buyers from around the globe.In a unique destination that entices guests with countless experiences to sense the moment, Angsana Oceanview Residences represent a rare opportunity to leverage from the well-established flagship of Angsana Hotels and Resorts, and to own a property designed for the luxury adventurers of the world.

Angsana Oceanview Residences are integrated into a proven rental programme that allows owners to maximise their returns by having their apartment professionally managed by Angsana Laguna Phuket. Until recently, not everyone could afford to become a resident of Laguna, the most prestigious area in Phuket. Laguna is an exceptional integration of several 5-star hotels and residential complexes, complete with all the elite neighborhood infrastructure such as a golf course, tennis courts, spa salons, beach clubs, shops, restaurants and bars, a free shuttle service, and even river trams that will take you to any of the hotels within the Laguna complex completely free of charge. The long-awaited Cassia aparthotel quickly became the most attractive vacation spot, offering tourists a wide selection of affordable apartments.

The aparthotel is located in a picturesque and completely safe environment on the shore of a freshwater lake that separates it from the beach. Guests can reach the 8-kilometer Bang Tao Beach in just minutes via the river tram that constantly runs across the lake from the hotel lobby. Cassia features its own beach club equipped with complimentary sun loungers. The common areas are fully equipped for a comfortable stay — a children's playground and a shallow pool with sea sand for the youngest residents, a swimming pool, sun loungers, a kids’ club, a beauty salon, and a coffee shop. The hotel lobby and security operate 24/7 on the premises.

The two-bedroom apartments are fitted with a stunningly functional kitchen. All living spaces — bedrooms, kitchen, and lounge area — are designed in the bright and cheerful spirit of the Cassia aparthotel. From the private terrace of the apartments, guests can enjoy breathtaking views of the Andaman Sea.

Hotel Cassia is located in the heart of Laguna Phuket Resort & Hotel Complex. It was built in 2015 and has become a favourite destination for tourists from all over the world. The hotel consists of two 6-storey buildings that are interconnected. The hotel is built in the Art Nouveau style, with very bright interiors of both the common areas and the apartments themselves. Комплекс Кокянг расположен на юге острова Пхукет, в центре популярного района Най-Харна, всего лишь в 5 минутах езды от пляжа ив 150 метрах от ресторанов и кафе. Комплекс состоит из 25 вилл в двух идентичных проектах, расположенных в 100 метрах друг от друга. Оба проекта находятся под круглосуточной охраной. Виллы с 2 и 3 спальнями спроектированы буквой L из панорамных окон комнат открывается вид на бассейн. Все виллы прекрасно декорированы и комфортны для проживания. Вилла с 3 спальнями состоит из двух здании. В первом размещена просторная гостиная, которая объединена с кухней и две спальни, с приватными ванными комнатами. Во втором - спальня с отдельной ванной комнатой. При выходе из виллы Вы окажетесь на террасе рядом с личным бассейном. Возле каждой виллы есть парковочное место под крышей.

Магазины, рестораны и массаж, находятся в шаговой доступности.

Один из лучших пляжей - Найхарн находится в 3 километрах от проекта. Пляж пользуется популярностью у семей с детьми и экспатов, по этому здесь вы не встретите большое скопление туристов. В двух шагах от пляжа есть пресноводное озеро и смотровая площадка с ветряными мельницами. Пляж Най Харн пользуется популярностью у семей с детьми, а также у зимовщиков и долгожителей острова. Отпуск здесь проводить комфортно, т.к. рядом множество ресторанов как европейской. так и национальной тайской кухни. Здесь же есть офисы с арендой транспорта и экскурсионными услугами. Для длительного проживания на Найхарне комфортно жить семьям с детьми - рядом расположены международные и тайские детские сады, интернациональные и русская школы. Путь от Найхарна до популярного детского игрового комплекс «Раваи парк» займет 5 минут на авто или байке.

Также Найхарн часто выбирают для йога-туров или спортивных кемпингов. На Найхарне и в соседнем с ним районе Раваи сосредоточены спортивные залы, специализированные ринги для занятий тайским боксом и площадки для воркаута. В 5 минутах езды находится гипер маркет Макро, супермаркет с европейскими продуктами Villa Market, рыбный рынок. Так же в этом районе сконцентрировано максимальное количество школ и детских садов.

Комплекс идеально подходит абсолютно всем категориям туристов. Отличное место для отдыха с детьми и для пар и компаний любого возраста. Виллы в проекте доступны, как для коротких каникул, так и для долгосрочной аренды.

Onyx Style Villas is one of the most popular and demanded projects in the south of Phuket from the famous developer Two villas Grope. Located in the heart of the tourist infrastructure of the Naiharn area, in close proximity to restaurants, shops and massage parlous. The construction was completed in 2014. The project includes 46 villas with two and three bedrooms, ranging from 158 m2 to 280 m2.

Onyx Style Villas are cosy one-storey villas with a private pool in a romantic atmosphere surrounded by lush greenery. Almost all villas in the project are two bedroom. Made in the same architectural style and design. A spacious living room with a seating area is combined with a fully equipped kitchen with a dining area. The living room doors lead directly to the pool in the garden, which is equipped with a barbecue area and sun loungers. The decor of the rooms is in the Modern Sino style, which makes these projects different from others. Onyx Style Villas offer a large master bedroom with pool access and a luxurious bathroom with a beautiful bathtub and walk-in shower. The second bedroom is slightly smaller, with its own private bathroom. There is no individual parking space for the villa, but there is a large car park at the entrance to the complex, which is guarded around the clock.

46 villas in the project are located in a closed, protected area, surrounded by a tropical garden.

The complex is located in the very centre of the developed tourist infrastructure of the Naiharn district, in close proximity to 7/11 shops, restaurants, massage parlous. One of the best beaches - Naiharn is located 6 kilometres from the project. The beach is popular with families with children and expats, so you will not find a large crowd of tourists here. A stone's throw from the beach, there is a freshwater lake and an observation deck with windmills. Nai Harn Beach is popular with families with children, as well as with winterers and long-livers of the island. It is comfortable to spend your vacation here, because Nearby there are many restaurants like European, and national Thai cuisine. There are also offices with transport rental and excursion services. For a long stay on Naiharn, it is comfortable to live for families with children - there are international and Thai kindergartens, international and Russian schools nearby. The way from Naiharn to the popular children's play complex "Rawai Park" will take 5 minutes by car or bike.

Naiharn is also often chosen for yoga tours or sports campings. At Naiharn and in the neighbouring Rawai district, there are gyms, specialized rings for Thai boxing and workout grounds. A 5-minute drive away is a hypermarket Makro, a supermarket with European products Villa Market, a fish market. The maximum number of schools and kindergartens is also concentrated in this area.

The complex is ideal for absolutely all categories of tourists. An ideal place for families with children and for couples of all ages. And also lovers of a calm and comfortable holiday on weekends.

Tri Vananda is a visionary wellness residential community set on 237 acres of forest and lakes in the peaceful area of Phuket. Rooted in biophilic and sustainable design, only 15% of the land is developed, resulting in a low-density, nature-integrated environment ideal for multigenerational living and long-term wellbeing.

The project features 77 private pool villas with two to four bedrooms, ranging from approximately 333 to 780 square meters. Buyers can select their preferred plot and choose from seven carefully designed layouts under two main villa styles: VANA and NANDA, each emphasizing light, space, and wellness-focused living.

VANA villas are designed with simplicity, openness, and connection to nature in mind. They offer double-height ceilings up to 6.7 meters, allowing generous natural light and ventilation throughout. All bedrooms enjoy panoramic lake and pool views. These villas include large outdoor pool decks, Thai and Western kitchens, ensuite bathrooms with garden views, and separate staff quarters. The layouts are crafted to support relaxed indoor-outdoor living with a focus on privacy and serenity.

NANDA villas combine modern architectural flow with wellness-enhancing features. They include curved-glass facades, lap pools up to 21 meters, large walk-in wardrobes, multi-functional rooms for work or relaxation, and barrier-free design elements that ensure accessibility for all ages. These homes are ideal for those seeking a future-proof and flexible lifestyle.

Tri Vananda is more than a collection of villas—it is a complete wellness destination. The community includes a cutting-edge integrative medical center offering diagnostics, functional and traditional therapies, cognitive health programs, and personalized wellness planning. Complementing this are a full-service spa with thermal suites, mindfulness pavilions on the lake, a fitness center with an Olympic-size pool, a juice bar, and a sauna.

The community’s social and lifestyle hub is the PRU Jampa Community House, which features a Michelin Green Star restaurant, lounge and bar, movement studios with advanced training systems, and wellness zones designed specifically for children and teenagers.

Located just 15 minutes from Phuket International Airport, Tri Vananda offers a rare balance of peaceful seclusion and convenient access to beaches, marinas, international schools, hospitals, and shopping.

Whether as a permanent residence, a wellness-focused retreat, or a long-term investment, Tri Vananda represents a new standard of holistic, luxury living in Phuket—blending privacy, nature, and health in perfect harmony.

Lake Residences is the third phase of the large-scale Gardens of Eden development in the Layan–Bang Tao area of Phuket. Created by Amal Development with architecture and landscape design by Tierra Design and Wonder by White Jacket, the project is built around a strong nature-focused and wellness-driven philosophy. Lake Residences is set along a scenic lake within the masterplan and offers a calm, park-like environment with extensive greenery, water features, and low building density. This phase consists of nine residential buildings with a total of 698 units, all positioned around the lake with a 150-metre pool and approximately 5,000 square metres of water surface, including areas with colorful fish. The development features underground parking with elevator access, keeping the internal spaces peaceful and free from traffic.

Gardens of Eden places a strong emphasis on lifestyle and wellbeing. Around 70% of the entire land area is dedicated to open green spaces, landscaped gardens, and recreational zones. Residents will have access to a wide range of facilities, including a large wellness center of about 5,000 square metres, multiple jogging and walking trails totaling 3.5 kilometres, kids’ play areas and clubs, two clubhouses, an open-air cinema, a pet park, several on-site restaurants, a business center, and a small supermarket. The broader development also incorporates an 80-room hotel, adding to the overall convenience and service level. Materials, design elements, and landscaping throughout the project follow a biophilic, eco-minded approach with a focus on natural materials and an abundance of greenery.

Lake Residences offers units on a long-term leasehold basis with a 90-year structure, while freehold ownership is available by request for an additional cost. Furniture packages are provided separately. Completion for this phase is targeted for the third quarter of 2028. Since it is an off-plan development, buyers should consider typical construction and delivery risks, along with the leasehold structure and long investment horizon. Despite this, the project stands out for its large scale, wellness concept, extensive facilities, and rare amount of natural open space, making it appealing for both long-term living and high-end resort-style use.

It offers 3 bedrooms. Total area is 123 m². The sea is approximately 501 m away. The unit is part of Lake Residences by Gardens of Eden .

Andara Residences provides the same luxury and lifestyle as a villa, but with more comfortable dimensions. All of these luxury gadgets have all the comforts and conveniences of a resort.

The apartments can be used as the main house or rented out by Andara management to generate rental income. In any case, these residences are the epitome of luxury apartments in the tropics.

The building, completed in 2010, has been meticulously designed and built to perfection. Its design combines five-star resort life with Thai / Balinese and contemporary architecture, with attention to detail in both home layout and building materials. The spacious open-plan villa is made up of two-story pavilions, each of which is connected by covered walkways to connect both indoor and outdoor living spaces. The interior of the house combines elements of South East Asia and modern design, an abundance of Minotti furniture and the most modern audiovisual systems, including the Sonos audio system.

Western 5-star hotels, spa with eight separate rooms, 300-area gym. .m offers a wide range of professional equipment and a 400 sqm spa pool. Each of the properties has an experienced management team that will support and meet all your needs !!

Upon completion in 2010, the villa is professionally managed by Andara Resorts staff and a local general manager.

The new owner will be able to use the same resort management team / company, select an alternative provider and / or manage the property.

Phuket International Airport is located just 18 km from the hotel complex. The city centre is 20 km away. A free shuttle service to the surrounding area is available for up to 1 km. A place of rest for your family, friends, as a romantic oasis for your couple. All, without exception, rooms are ready to accept families with children of any age. From here, owner and guests alike can enjoy the expansive ocean and mountain views. All roof-lines have been extended to give additional shade from the sun and shelter from the rain ceiling the summer months.

The pool, sun terrace and enlarged dining sala, all of which have to be experienced (along with the incredible views) to be believed.

Bathrooms and en-suites are large and luxurious with soft lighting and a superb use of mirrors to enhance the special ocean views. The large western style build-in in kitchen with a cooking rage, oven, double door fridge and dishwasher a delight to use.

The building, completed in 2010, has been meticulously designed and built to perfection. Its design combines five-star resort life with Thai / Balinese and contemporary architecture, with attention to detail in both home layout and building materials. The spacious open-plan villa is made up of two-story pavilions, each of which is connected by covered walkways to connect both indoor and outdoor living spaces. The interior of the house combines elements of South East Asia and modern design, an abundance of Minotti furniture and the most modern audiovisual systems, including the Sonos audio system.

Zenithy Pool Villas is a complex of four interconnected collections of contemporary villas with private pools, developed by Jenjad Pattana Development Co., Ltd. and located in the quiet residential area of ​​Cherng Talay (Pasak Soi 8) in the north of Phuket. The project offers a boutique villa format with high standards of finishing and service from the international company Knight Frank. Owners have a choice of freehold or leasehold ownership, and all legal and administrative costs for the transfer of ownership are divided 50/50 between the developer and the buyer.

Two-storey villas from 331 to 356 m² (Phase 1-2) and from 302 to 485 m² (Zenithy Connext and Luxe) on plots of 258-335 m².

Standard layout Phase 1–2: three bedrooms, each with its own bathroom, a guest area and a study; an open kitchen-living room on the ground floor; two bedrooms, a study and a patio area on the roof of the second floor.

Especially for object 18, the swimming pool has been increased to 3x10 m, a garage for two cars, a landscaped garden with automatic gates and a built-in jacuzzi (Phase 2).

The interiors are designed in light brown tones with gold and gray accents: high ceilings, panoramic floor-to-ceiling windows, modern furniture and built-in storage systems.

Phase 1 (Zenithy Villas): 12 villas S1–S12, completed by 2022 and completely sold out; now available only on the secondary market or for rent.

Phase 2 (Zenithy Villas Phase 2): 15 villas with extended gardens, automatic gates and a jacuzzi; completed in 2022.

Zenithy Luxe: 9 exclusive villas (3-4 bedrooms, ≈485 m²) in a modern Thai style; commissioning - December 2025.

Zenithy Connext: 7 boutique villas (3 bedrooms, 302-404 m²) with minimalist architecture and swimming pools; delivery - Q1 2026.

Private swimming pools with a salt cleaning system, CCTV video surveillance, high-speed Wi-Fi.

Fully equipped kitchen (western style) with a dishwasher, equipped with a laundry area (washing machine included, dryer not included).

Built-in smart home systems allow remote control of lighting, air conditioning and security.

Premium imported finishing materials: natural stone, designer fittings, teak parquet.

Monthly maintenance fee of 10,000 THB, one-time contribution to the reserve fund of 25,000 THB.

Professional landscape maintenance, 24-hour security, concierge service and regular cleaning of common areas.

Special rental conditions through partner platforms (Booking.com, Airbnb, Agoda) with separate numbering systems for properties to simplify management.

Zenithy Pool Villas combine the comfort of a private villa with high-class resort-level service, offering housing for family living, rental investments and a “second home” in Phuket.

Tri Vananda is a visionary wellness residential community set on 237 acres of forest and lakes in the peaceful area of Phuket. Rooted in biophilic and sustainable design, only 15% of the land is developed, resulting in a low-density, nature-integrated environment ideal for multigenerational living and long-term wellbeing.

The project features 77 private pool villas with two to four bedrooms, ranging from approximately 333 to 780 square meters. Buyers can select their preferred plot and choose from seven carefully designed layouts under two main villa styles: VANA and NANDA, each emphasizing light, space, and wellness-focused living.

VANA villas are designed with simplicity, openness, and connection to nature in mind. They offer double-height ceilings up to 6.7 meters, allowing generous natural light and ventilation throughout. All bedrooms enjoy panoramic lake and pool views. These villas include large outdoor pool decks, Thai and Western kitchens, ensuite bathrooms with garden views, and separate staff quarters. The layouts are crafted to support relaxed indoor-outdoor living with a focus on privacy and serenity.

NANDA villas combine modern architectural flow with wellness-enhancing features. They include curved-glass facades, lap pools up to 21 meters, large walk-in wardrobes, multi-functional rooms for work or relaxation, and barrier-free design elements that ensure accessibility for all ages. These homes are ideal for those seeking a future-proof and flexible lifestyle.

Tri Vananda is more than a collection of villas—it is a complete wellness destination. The community includes a cutting-edge integrative medical center offering diagnostics, functional and traditional therapies, cognitive health programs, and personalized wellness planning. Complementing this are a full-service spa with thermal suites, mindfulness pavilions on the lake, a fitness center with an Olympic-size pool, a juice bar, and a sauna.

The community’s social and lifestyle hub is the PRU Jampa Community House, which features a Michelin Green Star restaurant, lounge and bar, movement studios with advanced training systems, and wellness zones designed specifically for children and teenagers.

Located just 15 minutes from Phuket International Airport, Tri Vananda offers a rare balance of peaceful seclusion and convenient access to beaches, marinas, international schools, hospitals, and shopping.

Whether as a permanent residence, a wellness-focused retreat, or a long-term investment, Tri Vananda represents a new standard of holistic, luxury living in Phuket—blending privacy, nature, and health in perfect harmony.
