The Oasis project is a unique development that reimagines resort living by seamlessly blending modern architectural sophistication with the tranquility of nature. Nestled on the stunning island of Phuket, this development offers an unparalleled lifestyle experience. It emphasizes a "ready-to-live" philosophy, ensuring that each villa is fully equipped to meet the needs and desires of its residents without the hassle of extensive customization or renovation. Every aspect of the project has been meticulously designed to harmonize with its natural surroundings while providing the ultimate in luxury and functionality.

The development comprises 26 exclusive villas, each thoughtfully designed with a built-up area ranging between 360 and 380 square meters. The villas are complemented by spacious patios that vary in size from 480 to 750 square meters. Inspired by Mediterranean aesthetics, the architecture incorporates North African textures and colors to create a warm and inviting ambiance. Each villa is a two-story structure featuring four bedrooms, five bathrooms, a private swimming pool, and a two-car garage. Equipped with advanced smart home systems, these residences provide both convenience and security.

The villas themselves reflect a unique architectural vision, designed to align seamlessly with the natural slopes of the terrain. Depending on their placement, villas are categorized into three layout types—those situated above, under, and alongside the slopes. The interiors are designed to the highest standards, offering two customizable color schemes and a selection of built-in and patio furniture. Modern appliances, including induction hobs, refrigerators, and air conditioners, are integrated into each home, while soft furnishings such as carpets, curtains, and linen sets enhance the comfort and aesthetic appeal. Additionally, authentic design elements crafted by local artisans add a distinct charm to the interiors.

Outdoor spaces are equally impressive, with landscaped patios and courtyards adorned with lush tropical vegetation. Private swimming pools, complete with garden furniture and summer showers, form an integral part of each villa. Shaded arcades provide respite from the tropical climate, making outdoor living an enjoyable experience year-round.

The Oasis development has been designed to foster a sense of community while maintaining a serene and secure environment. The village is safeguarded by 24/7 security, ensuring peace of mind for its residents. The landscape design is harmonized throughout the community, featuring roof gardens and terraces that blend seamlessly with the natural surroundings.

A key philosophy of the Oasis project is its commitment to providing homes that are completely ready for occupancy. The concept of “Absolute Homespace” ensures that each villa is delivered fully furnished and equipped, from furniture arrangements to kitchen setups. This attention to detail eliminates the need for renovations or additional preparations, offering residents a seamless transition into their new home.

The project’s location also places residents in proximity to a wealth of attractions. Dining and entertainment options abound, with destinations such as Boat Avenue and the Bang Tao Night Market offering vibrant experiences. Beach clubs like Catch and Maya provide lively nightlife, while the Laguna Golf Club caters to golf enthusiasts. For those seeking leisure and shopping, options such as the Green Elephant Sanctuary Park, Central Phuket Festival Mall, and Tesco Lotus are just a short drive away.

description:

Andara Resort is located on Kamala Beach, a 3 km stretch of beach on the west coast of Phuket. The beach is adjacent to the Andaman Sea, calm, relatively quiet time, but at the same time within easy reach of the small friendly village of Kamala.

There is a pristine beach at your doorstep, so there is no need to explore further. Kamala Beach is stunningly beautiful with crystal clear waters, white sand and gentle waves. The Millionaire Row where Andara Resort Villas can be found is an exclusive community of luxury hotels that attracts many wealthy expatriates from around the world. The entire area is dotted with private villas and hotels, resorts and signature beach clubs that are increasingly difficult to find around the world today. The area is quiet enough, but within easy reach of the friendly village of Kamala, within walking distance of the resort where you can find a wide variety of shops, restaurants, including a supermarket with everyday products. Phuket Island offers World Class, Medical Facilities, Golf Courses, Marina and Diving Centers as well as large shopping malls offering branded products.

Space, light, comfort and luxury are only four words we hear on a regular basis when people describe this villa, all of which are very apt. The villa has one master bedrooms and a further three guest bedrooms, all with luxurious en-suites and jaw-dropping sea views. The main living, dining and entertainment areas are well positioned with easy access to the large sun terrace and infinity swimming pool. From here, owner and guests alike can enjoy the expansive ocean and mountain views. All roof-lines have been extended to give additional shade from the sun and shelter from the rain ceiling the summer months.

The pool, sun terrace and enlarged dining sala, all of which have to be experienced (along with the incredible views) to be believed.

The internal areas, like all the bedrooms, enjoy the natural feel of rich hardwood flooring, architraves and matching doors, silk lined wall inserts and high vaulted ceilings. Bathrooms and en-suites are large and luxurious with soft lighting and a superb use of mirrors to enhance the special ocean views. The large western style build-in in kitchen with a cooking rage, oven, double door fridge and dishwasher a delight to use.

The building, completed in 2010, has been meticulously designed and built to perfection. Its design combines five-star resort life with Thai / Balinese and contemporary architecture, with attention to detail in both home layout and building materials. The spacious open-plan villa is made up of two-story pavilions, each of which is connected by covered walkways to connect both indoor and outdoor living spaces. The interior of the house combines elements of South East Asia and modern design, an abundance of Minotti furniture and the most modern audiovisual systems, including the Sonos audio system.

Western 5-star hotels, spa with eight separate rooms, 300-area gym. .m offers a wide range of professional equipment and a 400 sqm spa pool. Each of the properties has an experienced management team that will support and meet all your needs !!

Upon completion in 2010, the villa is professionally managed by Andara Resorts staff and a local general manager.

The new owner will be able to use the same resort management team / company, select an alternative provider and / or manage the property.

Properties in the offer on a VERY LEVEL with a secured land lease structure that ensures the security of foreign ownership.

Five-star hotel Andara Resort is located on the west coast of Phuket. The hotel has 26 villas and 37 luxury apartments with magnificent sea views. Respectable interior furnished with precious rocks, walls decorated with Jim Thompson silk, Thai artifacts, candles and incense along with modern equipment create an unusually sophisticated and comfortable atmosphere for a premium holiday. The area of apartments and villas: the minimum room is 153 sq. m, the maximum is 2100 sq. m!

Andara Resort has all the infrastructure of a 5* hotel. On site, guests can relax at the Andara Spa. There is an opportunity to do a hairstyle, pedicure, manicure, etc. Lovers of steam are available free access to the sauna. Fashionable SILK restaurant, pampering guests with Thai and international dishes. In SILK you can always please yourself with a variety of dishes, and of course, there is always the opportunity to order a private dinner. For children, a fun children's menu and entertainment are offered. Children's mini-club with a games room and a playground. The animation team and educators will not let the kids get bored. The fitness center is equipped with modern simulators, power stations, equipment. To choose the right training regime will help a professional coach. Group classes are also held here. Guests can work out in the gym until 8 p.m. And if you want to practice at night, they will open it on a call. In the beach club Beach Club you can sunbathe on double sunbeds, swim or do sea sports - windsurfing, parasailing, ride a scooter, banana or catamaran. The Beach Club is a 7-minute walk or a 2-3 minute shuttle ride from the reception from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.
specs: Sea View, Pool view, Urban View, Mountain View

The Title Nai Yang is a modern resort complex, which consists of seven

The apartment’s interior is designed in soft, light tones. Clever design solutions have made it possible to create space even in the smallest apartments. This cozy 36 sq.m studio successfully fits a double bed, bedside tables, a wardrobe, a fold-out sofa with a lounge area, a fully equipped kitchen, and a dining area. A subtle glass partition visually separates the bedroom from the living room, a feature sure to be appreciated by families with children.

The Title Nai Yang is a modern resort complex, which consists of seven buildings of 6 and 7 floors and has 472 apartments: studios 36-39m2, one-bedroom apartments with an area of ​​46m2 or two bedrooms, the territory of the complex itself is fenced and is under 24-hour video surveillance and security ... The concept of the project and design is somewhat unusual for Thailand, the complex is decorated with red brick, and it looks more like a medieval castle than a modern Asian condominium. The apartments have a comfortable layout, in light grey and blue colours. The common area is a beautiful, well-groomed recreation park, a river flows along the buildings, which gives the project a certain charm and beauty of the fusion of modern urban architecture with nature.

The complex has its own restaurant, which serves breakfast, lunch and dinner a-la carte. Each building has access to a communal pool and well-kept garden. 5 swimming pools in each building are located on the 1st floor, and the sixth is on the roof of one of the buildings. There is a recreation area on the same roof. The complex offers a free gym, two saunas, a reception, a play area for children in the form of a pirate ship. Parking for 240 cars is organized on the south side of the building and is separated by green spaces and a fence.

The complex blends in perfectly with the tropical environment, and walking to the beach is a real pleasure. Just 5 minutes, and you will find yourself on one of the most stunning beaches in Phuket - Nai Yang. A small, cosy beach with a length of just under 3 kilometres, the water area of ​​which is protected by coral reefs, will allow you to enjoy swimming in the sea all year round, regardless of the season. Since 1986, this beach has been part of the Sirinath National Park Marine Park and all motor sports are prohibited on it. There is a large selection of restaurants, bars and cafés along the beach. The Title project itself separates the famous 5 * hotel The Slate from the beach with excellent gourmet restaurants. A five-minute walk is a local grocery market and mini markets.

The proximity to the sea and low prices make this project one of the most attractive on the island. And the peculiarity of the Nai Yang beach, on which there are never waves, even in low season, makes the project popular all year round. The entrance to the water is very shallow, so the beach is loved by families with small children. The low cost of apartments, both for rent and for purchase, makes the project accessible to everyone.

Nai Yang is a sought-after location in Phuket with convenient access to beaches, restaurants, services and tourist infrastructure.

It offers -1 bedroom. Total area is 36 m². The sea is approximately 350 m away. The unit is part of The Title Residencies Naiyang.
specs: Lifestyle for Expats in Nai Yang

Millennium Condominium is a modern residential development located in Bang Tao, Phuket, just 750 metres from the beach. The project combines contemporary tropical architecture, lush greenery, spacious leisure areas and resort-style facilities, creating an attractive environment for both personal living and investment.

The development comprises two seven-storey buildings with a total of 253 residences. Buyers can choose from studios ranging from 24 to 30 sqm, one-bedroom apartments measuring 34–46 sqm, and two-bedroom residences ranging from 52 to 72 sqm. Additional rooftop facilities include a bar with a bartender, hammam, open-air cinema, children's pool, air-conditioned children's playroom, yoga area, outdoor sports court, sun loungers and an event space.

Selected residences will offer direct access to a swimming pool, while a fitness centre will be located on the second floor. Other features include tropical landscaping, balconies with miniature gardens and automatic irrigation systems, as well as underground parking with 75 spaces.

The location in Bang Tao provides convenient access to one of Phuket's popular beaches, along with restaurants, cafés, shops and other lifestyle amenities. Bang Tao Beach is approximately 750 metres from the development.

Millennium Condominium is an appealing option for buyers seeking modern apartments close to the beach, with extensive resort-style facilities and tropical surroundings. The project is suitable for personal residence and holiday use, as well as for investment with potential rental opportunities.

Six beautiful colonial-style houses are spread around a stunning lake and an impressive pool featuring a cascading waterfall. The pristine white buildings are immersed in lush exotic gardens—a paradise rich with birds and flowers, white lilies, and fragrant jasmine trees. Plus, the beach is just a few leisurely minutes’ walk away!

The relaxing and cozy living room is decorated with Thai silk, cotton, and wood; the modern, fully equipped Western-style kitchen and bedroom feature a large double bed and an en-suite bathroom with both a bathtub and shower. French doors open from the bedroom onto a spacious 12 m² veranda, furnished with a comfortable sofa and a dining table for five. From the veranda, you can enjoy picturesque views of the mountains, pool, and lake.

With its delightful and timeless design, lush gardens bursting with exotic blooms, top-notch service, convenient location, outstanding value, and genuine privacy, these apartments will captivate anyone seeking a unique and personalized retreat in Thailand.

Ocean Breeze is an award-winning complex that was built in 2006 and is still a favourite destination for expats and visitors to Phuket today. The complex consists of three-storey buildings surrounded by a lake and pool. Ocean Breeze has 3 types of apartments: studios, one and two-bedroom units. All apartments overlook a picturesque garden, pool and lake. There are 50 spacious apartments in the project. With its delightful and timeless design, lush gardens glowing with exotic flowers, first-class service, convenient location, great value for money and genuine privacy, this apartment will enchant anyone looking for a unique, personalised holiday in Thailand.

The Ocean Breeze has a communal swimming pool with sun loungers and showers, a gym and walking paths. You can get to the beach by rented motorbike or car and it only takes 5 minutes.

Ocean Breeze is located just a 5-minute drive from Bangtao Beach. This beach is where Phuket's most popular beach clubs are located, such as Xana Beach Club, Dream Beach Club and Catch Club. The nearby Laguna Phuket Golf Club hosts international tournaments. Inexperienced golfers can use the services of a personal golf coach. A 10-minute drive from the complex is the Boat Avenue shopping complex with many shops, countless restaurants and bars, Villa Market supermarket of European products. The modern Porto De Phuket shopping complex, with countless restaurants, Tors supermarket, boutiques and food court, is just a short drive away. Nearby is the Lemonade Kids Club with a children's room and a pool for children, a hot sauna for adults. The bustling party scene of Patong is a 30-minute drive from the complex. The road from the airport to the complex will take about 25 minutes.

Ocean Breeze is located in one of the most prestigious areas of Phuket with developed infrastructure, but the cost of housing is relatively low. Therefore, the project is suitable for all those who prefer a measured rest surrounded by beautiful landscapes.

name: Nai Yang — Studio Apartments, with pool view in The Title Residencies Naiyang project, on Nai Yang beach
description:
Studio Apartments, with pool view in The Title Residencies Naiyang project, on Nai Yang beach

The apartment’s interior is designed in soft, light tones. Clever design solutions have made it possible to create a functional space even in the smallest apartments. This cozy 36 sq.m studio successfully accommodates a double bed, bedside tables, a wardrobe, a fold-out sofa with a lounge area, a fully equipped kitchen, and a dining zone. A subtle glass partition visually separates the bedroom from the living room, a feature sure to be appreciated by families with children.

The apartment’s interior is designed in soft, light tones. Clever design solutions have made it possible to create a functional space even in the smallest apartments. This cozy 36 sq.m studio successfully accommodates a double bed, bedside tables, a wardrobe, a fold-out sofa with a lounge area, a fully equipped kitchen, and a dining zone. A subtle glass partition visually separates the bedroom from the living room, a feature sure to be appreciated by families with children.

The Title Nai Yang is a modern resort complex, which consists of seven buildings of 6 and 7 floors and has 472 apartments: studios 36-39m2, one-bedroom apartments with an area of ​​46m2 or two bedrooms, the territory of the complex itself is fenced and is under 24-hour video surveillance and security ... The concept of the project and design is somewhat unusual for Thailand, the complex is decorated with red brick, and it looks more like a medieval castle than a modern Asian condominium. The apartments have a comfortable layout, in light grey and blue colours. The common area is a beautiful, well-groomed recreation park, a river flows along the buildings, which gives the project a certain charm and beauty of the fusion of modern urban architecture with nature.

The complex has its own restaurant, which serves breakfast, lunch and dinner a-la carte. Each building has access to a communal pool and well-kept garden. 5 swimming pools in each building are located on the 1st floor, and the sixth is on the roof of one of the buildings. There is a recreation area on the same roof. The complex offers a free gym, two saunas, a reception, a play area for children in the form of a pirate ship. Parking for 240 cars is organized on the south side of the building and is separated by green spaces and a fence.

The complex blends in perfectly with the tropical environment, and walking to the beach is a real pleasure. Just 5 minutes, and you will find yourself on one of the most stunning beaches in Phuket - Nai Yang. A small, cosy beach with a length of just under 3 kilometres, the water area of ​​which is protected by coral reefs, will allow you to enjoy swimming in the sea all year round, regardless of the season. Since 1986, this beach has been part of the Sirinath National Park Marine Park and all motor sports are prohibited on it. There is a large selection of restaurants, bars and cafés along the beach. The Title project itself separates the famous 5 * hotel The Slate from the beach with excellent gourmet restaurants. A five-minute walk is a local grocery market and mini markets.

The proximity to the sea and low prices make this project one of the most attractive on the island. And the peculiarity of the Nai Yang beach, on which there are never waves, even in low season, makes the project popular all year round. The entrance to the water is very shallow, so the beach is loved by families with small children. The low cost of apartments, both for rent and for purchase, makes the project accessible to everyone.

Nai Yang is a sought-after location in Phuket with convenient access to beaches, restaurants, services and tourist infrastructure.

It offers -1 bedroom. Total area is 36 m². The sea is approximately 350 m away. The unit is part of The Title Residencies Naiyang.

Foreigners cannot directly own land in Thailand. For this villa, the standard structure

is a registered 30-year leasehold with two contractual 30-year renewal

options, plus full freehold ownership of the building (the structure itself).

Lease is registered at the Land Office and noted on the title deed (Chanote).

Building / structure can be owned in the foreigner's name via a separate construction permit.

Alternative routes: Thai limited company ownership, BOI-approved investment, or a Thai-national long-term partner.

Kata sits on the southwest coast, two bays south of Patong and one north of Nai Harn. The area is built around two beaches, Kata Yai and the smaller Kata Noi, both with cleaner sand and calmer water than Patong, plus a reliable surf break from May to October that keeps a small but committed long-stay surf community on the island year round. The foreign population here splits into three groups: surf and dive instructors who came on a season and stayed, retirees who chose Kata over Rawai for direct beach access, and remote workers who rent condos in Kata Hills for the views. Day to day life is walkable along Kata Beach Road and Patak Road, with bakeries, Thai kitchens, two small supermarkets and a steady rotation of cafes opening and closing each season. Nightlife is low key compared to Patong: a handful of bars, the Ska Bar sundowner spot under the banyan tree, and the weekend Kata Night Market for street food. Schools require a car, with Kajonkiet the closest international option and the Phuket Town cluster reachable in 25 to 30 minutes. Healthcare is well covered by Mission Hospital and Bangkok Hospital Phuket on the Chalong side of the hill. The trade-offs are real high season traffic on the Patak hill road and limited supermarket options on site, but Kata works well for buyers who want a proper beach lifestyle without Patong density.

Kata Beach Road with cafes, dive shops and surf rentals; Kata Night Market (weekends) on Patak Road; Karon Plaza shopping strip (3 km north); Big C and Tesco Lotus in Chalong (10 km east) for full grocery runs.

Mission Hospital Phuket (12 km, private); Bangkok Hospital Phuket (14 km, JCI-accredited); Karon Sub-District Health Promotion Hospital (2 km, public clinic).
